title: E-commerce Customer Support & Dispute Specialist (PayPal Claims Expert)
description:
We run multiple 7-figure Shopify brands selling in the UK and EU. We're hiring ONE experienced Customer Support & Dispute Specialist for a long-term, stable position. This is not a beginner role – PayPal dispute experience is mandatory.



WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:

- Answer customer support
s across our brands (order status, refunds, shipping, product questions) – fast, professional, empathetic

- Communicate with our suppliers/fulfillment agents daily: request address corrections before shipment, chase tracking updates, resolve stuck or lost parcels, request reshipments when needed

- Own the full dispute workflow: PayPal disputes & claims, Visa/Mastercard chargebacks, Shopify Payments disputes

- Build winning dispute responses: compile tracking proof, delivery confirmation, customer communication, terms acceptance

- Prevent disputes before they happen – spot angry customers early, offer resolutions, keep our chargeback rate below scheme thresholds

- Process refunds/returns per our policies and log everything cleanly



YOU MUST HAVE:

- Hands-on experience winning PayPal disputes and claims (you know the difference between a dispute, claim, and chargeback – and how to handle each)

- Chargeback rebuttal experience with card processors (Stripe, Shopify Payments, or similar)

- Shopify admin experience (orders, refunds, timeline notes)

- Excellent written English – your
s ARE our brand

- Minimum 30 hrs/week availability, 6 days/week coverage preferred

- Reliable internet, own laptop, able to overlap with European hours (CET)



BONUS POINTS:

- Experience with health/beauty or supplement brands

- Familiarity with Proton
s, Shopify

- Experience keeping Visa/Mastercard dispute ratios under monitoring thresholds



HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS:

- Response time under 12 hours

- Dispute win rate

- Chargeback rate kept low through proactive resolution



WHAT YOU GET:

- Long-term role – our tea
mbers stay for years

- Salary paid on time, every single time

- 13th month pay after 1 year

- You're the only support person – full ownership, no micromanagement, direct line to the founder



HOW TO APPLY (read carefully – applications ignoring this are deleted):

1. Start your message with the word "RESOLVED"

3. Describe in 2-3 sentences how you would respond to a PayPal "Item Not Received" claim when you have tracking showing delivery.

One more thing – we're hiring today, not next week. If your answers look good, we'll do a quick chat, call and you can start immediately.

title: Video Editor (Performance Marketing/E-Commerce Brand)
description:
*PLEASE APPLY THROUGH TYPEFORM LINK: 
/to/NxLRG845 *



We're hiring: Video Editor (Remote or Hybrid) for a Performance Marketing/E-Commerce Brand



About TØTE



TØTE is a fast-growing Amsterdam-based bag and accessories brand built around one

mission: making everyday carry simple, functional, and timeless. Since launching in 2024,

we’ve shipped tens of thousands of orders across the world and built a client base that

values clean design, long-lasting materials, and products that actually make life easier.

We move fast, experiment constantly, and create with intention. Our brand is driven by

performance, minimalism, and storytelling and our content reflects that. From UGC and

lifestyle shoots to large-scale campaigns, we’re focused on producing visuals that feel

authentic, scroll-stopping, and unmistakably TØTE.



If you join us, you’ll become part of a small, ambitious, and creative team building one of the

most exciting consumer brands in Europe.



We’re looking for a skilled Video Editor who knows their way around short-form performance

content. Someone fast, detail-oriented, and obsessed with smooth pacing, tasteful shot selection,

and edits that actually convert.



This isn’t just about fancy transitions, we want someone who understands how to make

creatives that stop the scroll, grab attention, and drive results.



About the Role



As a Video Editor at TØTE, you’ll be transforming raw footage into scroll-stopping ads for

Meta and TikTok and more. You’ll work closely with the owners of the brand to bring

concepts to life across UGC, founder-led ads, and high-end shoots.

Speed, quality, and performance are key.



What You’ll Do



- Edit high-performing short-form video content (UGC, lifestyle, founder ads)

- Implement hooks, subtitles, overlays, pacing, and music with precision

- Follow brand guidelines and creative direction from the team

- Collaborate with strategists and designers to align visuals with messaging

- Apply feedback and iterate based on performance

- Deliver files in correct specs for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, etc.



Who You Are

- 2+ years of experience editing performance content

- Expert in Adobe Premiere Pro or CapCut

- Skilled in pacing, text overlays, storytelling, and basic motion

- Attention to detail, fast turnaround times, and a good eye for performance

- Comfortable working with English-speaking teams

- Autonomous, reliable, and open to feedback



Tools You’ll Use



- Adobe Premiere Pro or CapCut (required)

- Clickup (internal SOPs)

- Dropbox (file sharing)



Compensation

This is a freelance role compensated per concept.

Pay Per Edited Concept



$30,- USD



We value fast editors who don’t just cut clips, but build creatives that convert.

Ready to Apply?



Click here to apply through our typeform: 
/to/NxLRG845



Your CV / Portfolio

- 5 examples of short-form edits you’ve done

- A short Loom (optional) explaining how you approach editing

- Your availability



Let’s build the future of performance content together.



TØTE is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to

building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

title: Virtual Assistant full time
description:
We are an Ecommerce company with different stores across different niches mainly selling on Meta.

Looking forward to finding a trusted and long term VA to complete various admin tasks, funnel reviews (only review not building from scratch) and more.



DO NOT BOTHER APPLYING  IF YOU CAN'T SEND ME A VIDEO LOOM ANSWERING CLEARLY THE 3 QUESTIONS AT THE BOTTOM OF THIS POST, THANK YOU !



BENEFITS:

- Long term role for years to come: we value trust and loyalty

- Salary to be discussed based on efficiency / 5$ per hour + bonuses 

- Flexible hours - 6 days a week 

- Work load around 7 hours per day



RESPONSIBILITIES AND TASKS (in order of frequency):



- Admin task: check tracking number of incoming shipments daily and update tatus in our CRM + other menial admin tasks

- Check Funnels before launch (you won’t be building or translating the funnel but will be checking every details on the pages such as context / names / image size / links / etc)

- Generating AI static ads based on our top performing ads (don’t be scared to apply if you never did this task - if you can tweak a prompt and think on your feet, this won’t be too difficult).



We need someone who pays attention to details and can adjust based on our feedback. 

Our ideal prospect is also not afraid to ask questions and always double checks his work.

Training will be provided for the AI static generating task (big plus if you have already dabbled with AI tools such as Nano Banana Pro).



REQUIREMENTS:

- Available 6 days a week 

- You’ll need a second screen to perform some tasks

- Fast internet connection / backup generator in case of power outage

- Calm and focused environment (crucial)

- Answers promptly and ready to hop on a call during shift hours

- Tech-savvy and can navigate easily Google sheets, Canva and Ecommerce softwares / CRMs

- Detail-oriented and independent (will double check and triple check on his / her own)

- Emotional intelligence and strong communication: can clearly enunciate any issue encountered or asks questions if needed





VIDEO LOOM APPLICATION:



If you've read this whole job post, send me a message starting with “READY” and answer precisely the next questions after briefly introducing yourself in a short loom video:



1. What is your current situation ? Any imperatives such as family, church, studies, etc.

We expect you to be available 6 days a week as this is a full time role and are looking for someone who will be part of our team only (no other company work allowed).

No need to go into details but we must know what is taking up your time outside of work.

Exemple: “I go to Church every Sunday from 8 to 11am approximately”.

Or “I might need to take care of my relatives on that day” etc.



2. Where do you live exactly in the Philipines and what’s your internet speed ?

We expect you to have a backup solution in case of power outage. 



3. Give us a detailed breakdown of your prior work experience and study curriculum if applicable (both remote and non remote work).

You will also explain why your contract ended for each job.

Example: “I worked for a video editing company from June 2023 to July 2025. During that time, I only worked for that company for which my only task was to edit videos following their guidelines. 

My contract with them stopped as their company stopped operating in July 2025.”

Include all contracts / jobs even if contract lasted for a week. 

You must state TIMELINE OF WORK (this means how long you worked for the client / company) and TASKS PERFORMED. 

Do not enumerate meaningless tools or CRMs, explain the task performed everyday on the job.





Please be honest in your answers. We value trust and long term commitment.

Looking forward to have you in the team and develop our relationship :)



Paul

title: SHOPIFY & GEMPAGES EXPERT / ECOMMERCE FUNNEL BUILDER
description:
SHOPIFY & GEMPAGES EXPERT / ECOMMERCE FUNNEL BUILDER



Every winning ad we run leads somewhere, and that somewhere is the page YOU build. We can have the best creatives in the market, but if the product page is slow, broken, or sloppy, the sale dies on arrival. That's why this role matters as much as it does.



We're hiring a Shopify & GemPages Expert who treats page building like a craft: pixel-accurate duplications, scripts followed to the letter, every app wired up correctly, and zero broken links by the time it reaches us. If you're the kind of builder who can't sleep knowing a button might be misaligned, you're exactly who we want.





SKILLS WE NEED



1. Shopify & GemPages Page Building

   You can build product pages, landing pages, advertorials, and full funnel pages inside GemPages. This is your core craft, not something you've dabbled in.



2. Accurate Page & Store Duplication

   You can take any page we show you and duplicate it precisely, across different Shopify stores, without breaking structure or losing detail.



3. Script-Exact Execution

   You follow provided scripts exactly. You place translated text correctly, keep the structure intact, and don't "improve" things we didn't ask you to change.



4. Funnel & Offer Setup

   You know how to set up post-purchase upsells, downsells, bundles, subscriptions, and digital files (ebooks) so the full funnel works end to end.



5. Shopify App Configuration

   You can install and configure the apps that power our funnels, correctly the first time.



6. Quality Assurance & Attention to Detail

   You catch broken links, missing text, untranslated copy, misplaced images, and mobile issues before they ever reach us. Nothing ships half-done.



7. Multi-Market Building

   You've built for German, French, and US audiences and know how to handle translated content properly within each store.



8. Fast Execution

   You work quickly without sacrificing quality, and you take ownership of a task from start to finish.





TOOLS WE USE (AND THAT YOU SHOULD KNOW)



Core Platform

   - Shopify (store setup, theme customization, policy pages)

   - GemPages (must be expert level, this is the heart of the role)



Upsells, Bundles & Subscriptions

   - OCU for post-purchase upsells and downsells

   - Kaching Bundles for bundle offers

   - Kaching Subscriptions for subscription offers



Digital Products

   - Fileflare (or similar) for ebooks and digital file delivery



Supporting Apps

   - Review apps

   - Tracking apps

   - Page builder apps

   - Upsell / cross-sell apps

   - Conversion optimization apps



Collaboration

   - Tools for coordinating with management, creative strategists, media buyers, and ops (Google Workspace, Slack, ClickUp, or similar)



If you're already fluent in OCU, Fileflare, Kaching Bundles, and Kaching Subscriptions specifically, you move to the top of the list.





JOB SCOPE (WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO)



1. Build Pages

   Create product pages, landing pages, advertorials, and funnel pages in GemPages based on the scripts and designs we provide.



2. Duplicate Pages & Stores

   Replicate pages we show you and copy internal pages across different Shopify stores accurately.



3. Place Translated Content

   Build pages for German, French, and US audiences, placing translated text exactly where it belongs based on the provided script.



4. Set Up Offers

   Configure post-purchase upsells and downsells (OCU), bundles (Kaching Bundles), subscriptions (Kaching Subscriptions), and digital files (Fileflare).



5. Configure Apps & Policy Pages

   Install and set up required Shopify apps, plus all policy and support pages: Privacy, Return, Refund, Shipping, Terms, Subscription Policy, Contact, and FAQ.



6. Quality-Check Everything

   Before submitting, verify every link, button, image, text, translation, and integration works, on both mobile and desktop, across the full customer journey.



7. Work With The Team

   Coordinate closely with management, creative strategists, media buyers, and the operations team to keep builds aligned and on time.





QUALITY ASSURANCE STANDARD (NON-NEGOTIABLE)



Before any task is submitted, you must confirm:

   - All links are correct and all buttons work

   - All images are placed correctly, none misplaced

   - No text is missing and nothing is left untranslated

   - All sections are properly aligned

   - Both mobile and desktop versions work

   - All apps are properly integrated

   - All upsells, downsells, bundles, and subscriptions work

   - All digital files / ebooks are properly connected

   - All policy pages are correctly set up

   - The full customer journey works from start to finish





WHAT YOU MUST BRING



   - Extensive, expert-level Shopify experience (not basic)

   - Extensive, expert-level GemPages experience

   - Proven, accurate page and store duplication skills

   - Hands-on experience with OCU, Fileflare, Kaching Bundles, and Kaching Subscriptions

   - Experience building for German, French, and US ecommerce stores

   - A strong, reliable quality-control process

   - The ability to follow scripts exactly and work fast without dropping quality

   - Strong ownership, communication, and attention to detail





THIS ROLE IS FOR YOU IF



You're a Shopify and GemPages expert who can duplicate any page accurately, follow a script to the letter, set up every app correctly, and check everything before submitting. You work fast, you're obsessive about detail, and you take ownership of the final result.





THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF



You only have basic Shopify experience, you're not strong in GemPages, you can't duplicate pages accurately, you skip the QA step, or you submit unfinished work. If you're not detail-oriented, this isn't the role for you.





TO APPLY



Please send:

   - A short introduction about yourself

   - Your Shopify experience

   - Your GemPages experience

   - Ecommerce or dropshipping brands you've worked with

   - Examples of Shopify pages you've built

   - Examples of pages you've duplicated

   - Shopify apps you have experience with

   - Your experience with OCU, Fileflare, Kaching Bundles, and Kaching Subscriptions

   - Your experience with German, French, and US ecommerce stores

   - Your availability

   - Your expected monthly rate





SCREENING QUESTIONS



1. How many years of Shopify experience do you have?

2. How many years of GemPages experience do you have?

3. Have you duplicated Shopify or GemPages pages before? Please provide examples.

4. Have you worked with German, French, or US ecommerce audiences before?

5. Are you comfortable following a provided script exactly when building a page?

6. What Shopify apps do you have the most experience with?

7. Have you set up post-purchase upsells and downsells using OCU before?

8. Have you set up bundle offers using Kaching Bundles before?

9. Have you set up subscriptions using Kaching Subscriptions before?

10. Have you set up ebooks or digital files using Fileflare or similar apps before?

11. What is your quality control process before submitting a completed page?

12. How do you make sure all links, buttons, translations, images, and integrations are working correctly?





At Aurum LLC, the pages you build are where our ad spend turns into revenue. If you're the right person for this role, we encourage you to apply.

title: CREATIVE STRATEGIST WITH MEDIA BUYING EXPERTISE (eCommerce / Dropshipping)
description:
CREATIVE STRATEGIST WITH MEDIA BUYING EXPERTISE (eCommerce / Dropshipping)



We're a multi-brand eCommerce company scaling across the German, French, and US markets. We're looking for a Creative Strategist who lives and breathes direct-response advertising, someone who can engineer winning ads, understand exactly how they perform inside the ad account, and keep producing fresh angles that move revenue.



This is not a "make pretty content" role. If you bring fresh ideas, proven results, and the ability to perform under pressure, keep reading.





SKILLS WE NEED



1. Winning Ad Research & Reverse-Engineering

   You can dig through spy tools, find ads that are clearly winning, and break down exactly WHY they work. More importantly, you can take that winning angle and build a brand-new original script from it that we can own.



2. Direct-Response Script Writing

   You write scripts for image ads, video ads, advertorial pages, and product pages that sell. You understand hooks, angles, emotional triggers, and problem-solution frameworks, not just clever wording.



3. Multi-Market Creative Strategy

   You can write for German, French, and US audiences and make each one feel native. You understand that an angle that crushes in the US might flop in Germany, and you adjust accordingly.



4. Creative-to-Performance Analysis

   You don't just create ads, you read how they perform. You can look at the numbers and know whether the problem is the ad, the offer, the landing page, the audience, or the product.



5. Offer & Angle Development

   You constantly generate new angles, hooks, concepts, and offers. You don't run dry after three ideas.



6. Working Under Pressure

   You make fast, data-driven decisions when revenue is on the line and you don't fold when performance drops.



7. Full Funnel Understanding

   You understand the entire Shopify dropshipping process, from the ad, to the product page, to checkout, so your creatives align with the whole buyer journey.





TOOLS WE USE (AND THAT YOU SHOULD KNOW)



Spy & Research Tools

   - Gethookd (must be expert level)

   - Kalodata (must be expert level)

   - Plus any similar ad spy and winning-product research tools you bring to the table



Advertising & Analytics

   - Meta Business Suite / Meta Ads Manager (for reading campaign performance)



Store & Funnel

   - Shopify (core platform for our stores and product pages)



Collaboration & Briefing

   - Tools for writing creative briefs and coordinating with editors and designers (Google Workspace, Slack, ClickUp, or similar)



If you're an expert in Gethookd and Kalodata specifically, you move to the top of the list. If you bring other strong spy tools we don't use yet, even better. We want someone who improves our stack, not just fits into it.





JOB SCOPE (WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO)



1. Research & Intelligence

   Use spy tools daily to find winning ads and products, study why they work, and feed that intel into our creative pipeline.



2. Script & Concept Creation

   Write scripts for image ads, video ads, advertorials, and product pages across the German, French, and US markets.



3. Angle Development

   Take winning ads, reverse-engineer the angle, and turn them into fresh, original concepts we can run as our own.



4. Performance Review

   Work alongside our media buyers, review ad performance, and identify which creatives to kill, improve, or scale.



5. Troubleshooting & Turnarounds

   When a product or campaign is underperforming, diagnose the real cause and propose new creative angles, offers, or page improvements to turn it around.



6. Briefing the Team

   Write clear, detailed creative briefs for our video editors and graphic designers so execution matches your strategy.



7. Bringing New Strategies

   Continuously introduce fresh techniques, testing ideas, and creative strategies that keep us ahead of competitors.





WHAT YOU MUST BRING



   - A proven track record with real results and achievements you can show us, not just talk about

   - Expert-level skill with spy tools, especially Gethookd and Kalodata

   - Expert script writing for image ads, video ads, advertorials, and product pages

   - The ability to analyze a winning ad's angle and build a fresh script from it

   - Extensive experience writing scripts for German, French, and US audiences

   - A solid understanding of the full Shopify dropshipping business process

   - The ability to handle pressure and make fast, data-driven decisions

   - Strong direct-response instincts and a deep grasp of customer psychology





NICE TO HAVE



   - Hands-on Meta Ads media buying experience

   - Experience turning around declining products or campaigns

   - UGC, podcast ad, and native ad scripting experience





THIS ROLE IS FOR YOU IF



You think in angles and hooks, not just visuals. You get excited reverse-engineering a competitor's winner. You can write for three very different markets and make each one feel native. And when performance drops, you don't panic, you diagnose.



If that's you, apply and show us your best work.

title: PAYPAL DISPUTE, SUBSCRIPTION DISPUTE & PREVENTION MANAGER
description:
PAYPAL DISPUTE, SUBSCRIPTION DISPUTE & PREVENTION MANAGER



We are looking for a highly experienced PayPal Dispute, Subscription Dispute & Prevention Manager who specializes specifically in PayPal disputes, claims, chargebacks, subscription disputes, and dispute prevention.



This role is not for a general customer support agent.



We need someone who deeply understands the full PayPal dispute process, knows how to handle every type of dispute situation, and has a proven track record of achieving a high win rate.



Most importantly, we need someone who can create, organize, and implement the right dispute workflows and SOPs to help us win more PayPal disputes, win subscription-related disputes, and prevent unnecessary PayPal disputes from happening in the first place.



Responsibilities



* Manage PayPal disputes, claims, and chargebacks

* Manage PayPal subscription and recurring payment disputes

* Prepare strong and complete dispute responses

* Submit evidence properly and on time

* Analyze each dispute and determine the best response strategy

* Handle Item Not Received disputes

* Handle Unauthorized Transaction disputes

* Handle Significantly Not As Described disputes

* Handle refund-related disputes

* Handle delivery and tracking-related disputes

* Handle subscription and recurring payment disputes

* Handle customer complaints before they turn into disputes

* Review PayPal cases daily

* Monitor dispute deadlines and required actions

* Work with customer service to collect needed evidence

* Work with fulfillment teams to collect tracking and delivery proof

* Improve PayPal dispute win rate

* Reduce unnecessary refunds and losses

* Identify the root causes of disputes

* Create workflows to prevent future disputes

* Create SOPs for every dispute situation

* Create SOPs for every subscription dispute scenario

* Train the customer service team on proper PayPal dispute handling

* Give management clear recommendations to reduce PayPal risk



Subscription Dispute Experience Required



The ideal candidate must have strong experience handling and winning PayPal disputes related to subscriptions and recurring payments.



We have subscription-based products, and subscription disputes can come from many different scenarios. We need someone who already understands these situations and knows how to prepare the best evidence, response strategy, workflow, and SOP for each case.



Subscription dispute scenarios may include:



* Customer claims they did not authorize the subscription

* Customer claims they did not know it was a recurring payment

* Customer claims they cancelled but were still charged

* Customer requests a refund after renewal

* Customer opens a dispute after receiving subscription product

* Customer claims subscription terms were unclear

* Customer claims they were charged without consent

* Customer claims they did not receive a subscription reminder

* Customer disputes multiple recurring payments

* Customer claims product was not as described

* Customer claims they only agreed to a one-time purchase



We need someone who understands how to win these cases by properly using evidence such as:



* Subscription terms and conditions

* Checkout consent

* Customer agreement proof

* Order confirmation

* Renewal confirmation

* Cancellation policy

* Refund policy

* Customer communication history

* Delivery and tracking proof

* Previous successful subscription deliveries

* Account activity or subscription history

* Screenshots of subscription terms shown before purchase



The person we hire must be able to create a complete Subscription Dispute SOP for every possible situation.



This includes:



* What evidence to collect

* What response to submit

* How to structure the rebuttal

* How to prevent similar disputes

* How customer service should respond before it becomes a dispute

* When to refund

* When to fight

* When to escalate

* How to protect the PayPal account from future risk



Dispute Prevention Responsibilities



We need someone who can help prevent PayPal disputes before they happen.



This includes creating workflows for:



* Item Not Received cases

* Delayed shipping cases

* Missing tracking cases

* Customer complaints

* Refund requests

* Subscription cancellation issues

* Subscription renewal complaints

* Address issues

* Delivery confirmation issues

* High-risk orders

* Payment concerns

* Escalated customer messages



The goal is not only to win disputes, but to stop avoidable disputes from happening.



What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is:



* Very experienced with PayPal disputes

* Very experienced with subscription disputes

* Very familiar with the full PayPal dispute process

* Strategic and aggressive enough to recommend the right solutions

* Strong at creating dispute workflows

* Strong at creating SOPs

* Strong at identifying weak points in current processes

* Experienced in improving PayPal dispute win rates

* Experienced in preventing PayPal disputes

* Experienced in winning subscription-related PayPal disputes

* Detail-oriented and deadline-driven

* Able to work independently

* Able to communicate clearly with management and customer service



Requirements



* Proven experience handling PayPal disputes

You will be responsible for reviewing live security camera feeds, tracking employee productivity, and maintaining accurate daily reports that help management improve warehouse efficiency.



Responsibilities:



* Monitor warehouse security camera feeds during assigned hours

* Track how many orders each packer completes

* Record productivity for each employee throughout the shift

* Categorize shipments by type:

    * Single-item shipments

    * Multi-item shipments

    * Priority shipments

    * Standard/Ground shipments

* Maintain detailed spreadsheets and daily reports

* Identify productivity trends and performance issues

* Report daily packing totals and efficiency metrics

* Verify workflow accuracy and consistency



Requirements:



* Exceptional attention to detail

* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

* Ability to focus for long periods while monitoring video feeds

* Reliable internet connection and computer

* Strong organizational skills

* Good written English communication

* Experience with logistics, operations, warehouse management, or data entry is a plus



Position Details:



* Remote position

* Full-time preferred

* Long-term opportunity

* Performance-based growth opportunities



To Apply:

Please send:



1. A brief introduction about yourself

2. Any experience with data entry, operations tracking, or warehouse monitoring

3. Your experience with Excel or Google Sheets

4. Your expected hourly rate

5. Your internet speed and computer specifications



We are looking for someone who is extremely detail-oriented and can accurately track warehouse productivity while maintaining organized daily performance reports for management.

Responsibilities:

* Calculate product profit margins

* Maintain inventory cost spreadsheets

* Track landed costs, shipping costs, and fees

* Create daily, weekly, and monthly profit reports

* Monitor product performance and profitability

* Track streamer sales performance and key metrics

Requirements:

* Reliable internet connection and computer

We are looking for someone who loves numbers, enjoys finding patterns in data, and can help us maximize profitability as we continue to grow.

title: Virtual Assistant with a Creative Storytelling Side (Long-Term, Full-Time)
description:
I run a growing content agency and I'm looking for a reliable, hard-working VA with excellent English and a creative mind, someone who wants a long-term home and is ready to grow with us as we scale.

This is a hands-on, high-output role. Your day-to-day will vary: researching trending content on US social media, organizing findings into docs and sheets, writing short captions and simple scripts, managing tasks on our project board, and supporting the team with whatever the week needs. Some days are research-heavy, some are writing-heavy. I'll teach you our systems and exactly how we work.

The creative side matters too: the best fit is someone who enjoys storytelling, notices why content goes viral, and can write short, natural, human-sounding captions and scripts when needed. You don't need to be a professional writer, but you need the instinct.

You're a fit if you:



Are a consistent, high-output worker who takes pride in delivering every single day

Write and speak excellent, natural English

Are organized, self-driven, and don't need hand-holding

Enjoy social media and understand US content culture

Have a creative, storytelling side (captions, scripts, ideas)

Want a long-term role and real growth, not a short gig



What the trial looks like (please read this carefully): We start with a 1-week paid trial with clear daily deliverables and a short daily check-in. I'm very transparent about expectations: this role is about consistent daily output, and the trial reflects the real job. If you deliver, this becomes a stable long-term position with room to grow.

Details: Full-time (8–10 hrs/day). $500–650/month depending on experience, paid every two weeks via Wise, with raises based on performance.

To apply: Start your message with the word "CONSISTENT". Then tell me two things in a few sentences: (1) one piece of US content trending right now (link it) and why you think it works, and (2) the highest-output week you've ever had in a job — what did you actually produce?

Generic applications will be ignored.

title: Experienced Credit Dispute Processor (CRC & CFPB Specialist)
description:
We are currently seeking a highly experienced Credit Dispute Processor to join our team. This is a critical role that requires precision, accountability, and deep knowledge of credit repair processes



Our goal is simple: deliver accurate, compliant, and effective results for every client.



Key Responsibilities:

- Manage and process client dispute files from start to finish

- Ensure all disputes are properly submitted and documented

- Maintain accurate client records and notes

- Monitor dispute progress and follow up on responses

- Handle escalations when necessary

- Ensure every file meets strict quality control standards

- Required Experience & Skills

- Credit Repair Cloud (CRC)

- Strong, hands-on experience with CRC

- Ability to onboard clients correctly

- Deep understanding of dispute rounds and workflows

- Maintain organized and updated records

- Credit Report Analysis



Must be able to:

- Analyze reports from all three bureaus

- Identify inaccurate, obsolete, duplicate, or fraudulent items

- Recognize collections, charge-offs, repossessions, bankruptcies, inquiries, late payments, and public records

- Develop dispute strategies based on each client’s report

- Credit Bureau Disputes

- Submit disputes to Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion

- Upload supporting documents properly

- Track confirmations, deadlines, and responses

- Know when and how to escalate disputes

- CFPB Complaint Experience (VERY IMPORTANT)

- Prepare and submit professional CFPB complaints

- Write strong, factual complaint narratives

- Upload supporting evidence

- Monitor complaint status and respond to bureau replies

- Escalate cases when needed

- Investigation & Documentation

- Review identity theft documents

- Process FTC Identity Theft reports

- Analyze police reports and supporting evidence

- Verify account ownership

- Keep all documentation organized and complete

- Compliance Knowledge

- Understanding of CROA, FCRA, and FDCPA

- Familiarity with Metro 2 reporting

- Knowledge of proper dispute and documentation practices

- Technology Requirements



Experience with:

- Credit Repair Cloud

- CFPB Portal

- LetterStream (preferred)

- IdentityIQ or similar platforms

- Google Drive, Docs, Sheets

- PDF editing tools

- Microsoft Office



What We’re Looking For:

- Extremely detail-oriented

- Honest and trustworthy

- Self-motivated and reliable

- Strong communication skills

- Ability to work independently

- Takes initiative and ownership

- Organized and deadline-driven

- Quality Control Standards



Before marking any file as complete, you must verify:

- Disputes were actually submitted

- CFPB complaints were filed when required

- Confirmation numbers are saved

- Client notes are updated

- Supporting documents are uploaded

- No steps are missed or incomplete



Important Notes:

- We are NOT looking for someone who is still learning

- We need someone who can perform this role at a high level immediately

- We value accuracy over speed and quality over quantity

- We would rather hire one exceptional processor than several average ones

- No agencies — individual applicants only



How to Apply:

If you meet the qualifications and have real experience in credit dispute processing, we would love to hear from you.



Please submit:

- Your resume

- Tools/platforms you’ve used

- A brief summary of your dispute and CFPB experience



Send your application to: 



Join us in building a team that treats every client file with care, precision, and integrity.



(Subject line format: Pink)

title: Social Media Coordinator
description:
We run two trade shows at TRADEX in Abbotsford, BC: the West Coast Women's Show and the West Coast Family Show, both November 20-22, 2026. We need someone who can both design original social content and keep our
 and Instagram pages active year-round, not just in the weeks before the show.



A lot of raw material comes from our exhibitors (vendors with booths at the show) and from us directly, but we need someone who can actually design with it, not just caption a photo and post it. Think real graphic design: announcement graphics, countdown and feature posts, vendor spotlights with your own layout and typography, simple motion on stills (subtle pans, animated text over photos), not filling in a premade template.



What you'll do:



- Design original graphics for announcements, exhibitor spotlights, and event features, working from photos we and our exhibitors supply

- Curate and select the best raw material from exhibitor submissions

- Write captions in our brand voice (we'll give you a detailed style guide)

- Tag the exhibitor's
/Instagram page in every relevant post

- Build and manage a posting calendar, scheduling across both shows' pages

- Reply to routine comments and messages

- Basic photo/video editing (colour, cropping, simple cuts) if usable footage comes in



What you won't need to do: source or shoot original photography/video on location, run paid ad campaigns, or contact exhibitors directly to request material, we handle that.



Please include a portfolio or work samples with your application, real designed social posts, not template examples. Hours start at 15-20/week and increase closer to the show (November). This is an ongoing, long-term role.

3. Show one winning ad you've spotted in Ad Library and explain why it's a winner.

title: Online ESL Teacher
description:
1. Provide one-on-one online English lessons for students with official course materials and standardized teaching procedures. Teach entirely in English and build an immersive learning environment.



2. Interact actively with students, encourage oral output, and correct pronunciation, grammar and expression errors. Adjust teaching speed and difficulty according to students’ English level.



3. Check internet, camera and microphone before every class. Ensure stable connection, clear audio and video. Be punctual for all scheduled classes. No unexcused absences, lags or class cancellations.



4. Submit complete and accurate class reports after each lesson, record students’ performance, strengths and weaknesses, and cooperate with the team to track students’ learning progress.



5. Follow all platform rules, dress codes and teaching disciplines, and maintain a professional teaching image during working hours.



6. Participate in regular teacher training and teaching evaluations to continuously improve class quality and student experience.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Growth & Scaling



Build, manage, and optimise sales funnels from top of funnel to conversion

Set up and maintain automations across GHL,
, and social platforms

Build and manage AI-powered automations that save time and scale operations

Manage founder's inbox, calendar, and daily schedule

Handle weekly live masterclass registrations, Zoom links, reminders, and replays

Manage GHL CRM — contacts, pipelines, automations, and lead tracking

Onboard new clients into our certification and mentorship programs

Draft
s and communications on behalf of the founder

Graphics & Content



Create on-brand Canva graphics for social media, events,
s, and ads

Produce slide decks, workbooks, and promotional assets

Maintain brand consistency across all platforms (black, gold, white)

Manage and organise the content library



Events & World Tour



Coordinate speaker communications and event logistics

Manage event registrations and attendee communications

Build event runsheets and briefing documents

Handle post-event follow-up and replay distribution



Social Media



Schedule and post content on Instagram and

Monitor DMs and comments, flag leads to the founder

Track masterclass funnel performance and report weekly





WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You must have:



3+ years experience as a VA, OBM, Operations Manager, or Growth Coordinator

A proven track record of helping businesses grow — not just maintaining, actively scaling

Experience building and optimising sales funnels and automation systems

Expert-level AI skills — especially Claude, Claude Code, and Claude Cowork

Strong Canva skills — you produce professional graphics without hand-holding

Excellent written English

Experience inside a coaching, events, or online business

A proactive mindset — you bring solutions, not problems

Reliable internet and a professional home setup



Big advantage if you have:



GHL (Go High Level) CRM experience — funnels, automations, pipelines, and campaigns

Experience scaling an online business or personal brand from 6 to 7 figures

Ability to set up and configure AI agents

Experience supporting a high-growth events or coaching business

Basic video editing skills

Passion for personal development or wellness





THE KIND OF PERSON WE WANT

You are fast. You are confident. You do not wait to be told what to do — you look at the business, see what needs to happen, and make it happen. You have helped companies grow before and you have the receipts to prove it. You understand funnels, automations, and scaling levers. You are obsessed with AI and use it every single day to think smarter, move faster, and come up with ideas nobody else is thinking of. You take ownership. You communicate clearly and proactively. You thrive in a fast-moving environment and you love the challenge of keeping a high-growth business organised and on track.

If you are cautious, slow, or need constant direction — this is not the right role. If you are sharp, results-driven, AI-savvy, and hungry to be part of building something world-class — we want to hear from you.



HOW TO APPLY

Your CV or resume

2–3 Canva graphics examples you have created

title: Graphic Designer / Creative Engineer
description:
We're hiring a Graphic Designer/Creative Engineer. The kind of person who can take design off the founder's plate entirely and push the brand's look somewhere better than he could take it himself.



You'll own the visual layer of a growing consumer brand end to end: main images, Amazon A+ content, the Shopify catalogue, ad and listing videos, the Brand Store, packaging. Everything a customer sees before they buy. You'll run image split tests to find what actually converts, render concepts for new products, and use AI to move faster on all of it. You'll have full access to Claude and whatever comes next.



This isn't a production-artist role where you wait for briefs. It's a design role with taste and real ownership. If you already make excellent work with minimal direction, and you want more autonomy, smarter tools, and a founder who'll get out of your way once you've earned it, read on.





YOU SHOULD APPLY IF



You make genuinely excellent, tasteful work with minimal direction. Your portfolio shows clean, modern, typographically literate design that would raise the bar on a brand, made without a creative director standing over you. This is the one thing we care about most.

You're an expert retoucher. Clean cutouts, correct colour, and sharp product images are second nature, not a stretch.

You can edit video end to end: cut, sound, thumbnail, export. Ad and listing content, not just stills.

You're AI-fluent (the Creative Engineer aspect). You actively use AI image and video tools in your daily work and you're always hunting the next one. Comfortable with prompting for product and environment shots.

You have a real eye for what sells online. You think about the customer looking at a listing, not just the composition.

You know Photoshop, Illustrator and Figma inside out.

Your written and spoken English is good enough to work async and take feedback cleanly.



DON'T APPLY IF



Your work is competent but generic, or only good when someone else art-directs it

You need a detailed brief to produce something good. Minimal direction is how we work

You treat AI as "something to dabble with" rather than core to how you work

You only do stills and can't or won't edit video

You don't much care whether the thing you made actually sells



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Own the visual layer



Design and refine main images across all marketplaces, to a standard that beats what sits next to us in search

Build and update Amazon A+ content, including translated versions across our international marketplaces (US, CA, MX, UK, AU, JP)

Rebuild and elevate the Shopify catalogue

Expert retouching across the catalogue



Cut the video



Edit UGC into ad and listing videos: choose the 
nts, optimise sound, export, make thumbnails, and hand to our Operations Manager for upload

Build workflows for AI-generated and AI-enhanced video



Find what converts



Run main image split tests in sync with marketing

Test main images against competitors to find winners (our Build it Backwards process)

Build and run polls, and tell us what the results actually say



Design the brand



Brand Store, product packaging, stickers, inserts

Hold the brand's visual identity as it scales



Help build the products



Render product and packaging concepts for new products and put them to polling

Teardown competitor products and listings to find where we can win

Bring product ideas, not just execution



BONUS SKILLS (NICE, NOT REQUIRED)



A real feel for International Typographic/Swiss Style and Dutch design. Our brand leans on it, so if this means something to you, tell us

Motion graphics or After Effects

3D or product rendering

Experience designing for Amazon and Shopify brands specifically



WHERE YOU FIT



You report directly to the founder to start

You'll work closely with the founder on the look and direction until we hire a Marketing/Growth Manager. Once they're in place, you report to them

You'll hand finished images and video to our Operations Manager for upload

Our Supply Manager will occasionally ask you for product design files



BENEFITS



US $1,800 to $2,000/month

Annual performance review with discretionary bonus tied to KPI delivery

40 hours/week, flexible schedule. Most of the work isn't time-sensitive, so you manage your own hours with a couple of hours of AEST/AEDT overlap for feedback

Work from anywhere in the world

We provide the Adobe Creative Cloud/Figma access; you bring a capable machine and a colour-accurate monitor

3-month probation; long-term engagement thereafter

Direct line to the founder and a real seat at the table as we grow

Job security: we've been in e-commerce since 2017 and we're hiring because we're scaling, not because something broke



TO APPLY

title: WooCommerce Funnel & Checkout Systems Builder
description:
# ???? WooCommerce Funnel & Checkout Systems Builder



We are building a custom WooCommerce-based funnel system that goes far beyond normal WordPress or ecommerce setups.



This is NOT a website building job.



This is NOT a plugin configuration job.



If that’s your skill set, stop reading here.



---



## ???? What this actually is



We are building a multi-step checkout system with conditional logic, where:



- users choose between different purchase paths

- flows change based on selections

- cart state updates dynamically across steps

- checkout reflects structured data, not just products

- WooCommerce is being extended, not used “as-is”



This is a system build, not a page build.



---



## ? This is NOT for you if:



- you only build WordPress pages or themes

- you rely on plugins to “make things work”

- you don’t understand WooCommerce hooks or cart behavior

- you think of checkout as a static page

- you need step-by-step instructions to figure out system logic



This will frustrate you and waste your time.



---



## ? This IS for you if:



- you understand WooCommerce at a structural level

- you think in systems, not pages

- you can trace what happens to data from click ? cart ? checkout ? order

- you are comfortable working with logic, not templates

- you can identify where systems break before they break



---



# ???? First Step (Required — Paid if completed correctly)



We use a different hiring process.



Instead of interviews, we evaluate real thinking.



You will be given a real funnel scenario (Alpha One system).



You must:



### 1. Go through the full funnel (pages 1–checkout)



### 2. Break down your thinking:

For each step, explain:



- What is the user doing?

- What is happening in the system?

- What changes in the cart or state?

- What do you believe must exist in WooCommerce to support this?



### 3. Generate your own logic:



You must also identify:



- what questions YOU would ask if you were building this

- where the system might break

- what is unclear or missing in the flow



---



## ?? Important



There are no provided questions.



You must generate the structure yourself.



We are not testing memorization.



We are testing whether you can reconstruct system logic from UI flow.



---



## ???? Allowed formats



You may respond using:



- written explanation

- step-by-step breakdown

- or simple flowchart format



Clarity matters more than format.



---



## ???? Compensation



This first test may be compensated ($3–$7 equivalent) if completed fully and correctly.



Incomplete submissions are not evaluated.



---



## ???? What happens next



Strong submissions will be moved into:



- deeper WooCommerce implementation tests

- real build environments

- production-level funnel work



This is a working system role, not a discussion role.



---



## ???? Final note



This is a high-clarity role.



It may be simple for the right person.



It will be confusing for the wrong one.



That is intentional.

title: Youtube Thumbnail Artist - AI Image Generation
description:
We run a network of YouTube channels across several niches : history, military, firearms, men's lifestyle & advice, farming/homesteading — doing millions of views per month. We're hiring ONE full-time thumbnail designer.



The job:



A thumbnail exists for ONE reason: to make a stranger stop scrolling and click. That is thumbnail psychology, and it is the entire job. AI image skills WITHOUT thumbnail psychology are worthless to us — a beautiful image nobody clicks is a wasted image and wasted money.



1. Start with psychology, not pixels: from our brief, lock the focal point, the emotion, and the curiosity gap. The reason a viewer HAS to click

2. Generate the base image with AI (we provide the accounts and image-gen budget) through deliberate, iterative prompting. Every prompt decision made in service of the click, not of "looking cool"

3. Finish in Photoshop or Canva: fix artifacts, composite, color grade, add text that reads at mobile size - judged by one question only: does this make more people click?



If you think of thumbnails as art, do not apply. If you understand that a thumbnail is click psychology rendered as an image, keep reading.



**You're the right person if:**



- You already work with AI image tools (GPT 2, Nanobanana 2 experience is a must) and can show your work WITH the prompts. Personal projects and fan thumbnails count — client work is NOT required

- You have visual taste: you can look at two thumbnails and explain why one gets clicked and the other gets scrolled past

- You know Photoshop, or you're strong in Canva and willing to learn Photoshop fast

- You apply feedback ONCE — we tell you something, you never make that mistake again

- You want one stable long-term employer, not gig work

- Be willing to work late at night to match with my timezone



**What you get:**



- 400$/month starting salary - View bonuses WILL be added if your performance leads to results

- Reviews at 3, 6, and 12 months — strong performers reach ?30,000+ within the first year

- AI Image credits provided

- Full-time, long-term. 



**Content note:** some of our channels cover military history and firearms in an educational/historical context. You must be comfortable designing thumbnails featuring weapons and war imagery.



**HOW TO APPLY — we delete applications that skip any step:**



1. Your subject line must begin with: **MAGENTA FALCON**

2. Attach your 3 best thumbnails — real client work, redesigns of existing videos, or fan thumbnails all count

3. Attach 2 AI-generated images along with the FULL prompt(s) you used for each, including your iterations

4. Look at the thumbnail on this video: 
. In 3–4 sentences: what's working, what's failing, what would you change?

5. Confirm your earliest start date



Generic or copy-pasted applications missing any of these 5 items will not be read.

title: Community Builder (for founders and CEOs)
description:
We're launching a founder-facing peer community on Circle, built around *The Breakout CEO* podcast and the Intellectual Strategies brand. This community is a professional network — not a fan club. It exists to warm potential clients, generate referrals, and surface guests, while giving members genuine peer value.



This role owns the community from the ground up: platform setup, founding member recruitment, weekly engagement, growth, health reporting, and the podcast newsletter. You'll work closely with the Marketing Operations Lead, who owns editorial direction across the broader content engine.



**This is not a role for someone who needs a lot of direction. It's a role for someone who knows how to build and sustain engagement with sophisticated professionals — and can prove it.**



ABOUT US

Intellectual Strategies is a U.S.-based fractional legal team helping innovators and scaling CEOs align legal and business strategy. Our founder, Jeff Holman, also hosts *The Breakout CEO* — a podcast featuring candid conversations with growth-stage leaders in SaaS, eCommerce, and tech.



Our audience is startup founders and scaling CEOs running businesses in the $1M–$50M+ range. We're building a professional peer community to serve that audience — and we're looking for someone to build and run it.



What You'll Own

Community

- Launch and ongoing management of the podcast-centric community on Circle

- New member onboarding and welcome experience — welcome sequence, orientation, first action prompt

- Weekly engagement calendar — discussion prompts, episode threads, member spotlights, polls, Q&As, and AMAs

- Community guidelines, culture standards, and moderation

- Founding member recruitment and VIP onboarding (starting with past podcast guests)

- Identify and cultivate power members — recognize them publicly, give them elevated roles

- Community growth and health reporting (monthly)

Podcast Newsletter

- Own the podcast newsletter end-to-end — editorial direction, writing, and consistent send schedule

- Content reflects community conversations, episode highlights, member wins, and relevant resources for startup founders and scaling CEOs

- Voice is professional, direct, and substantive — written for founders making high-stakes decisions, not a coaching or wellness audience

- Surfaces community highlights and member content to the MOL for cross-channel use

LinkedIn Podcast Page

- Monitor and respond to comments on The Breakout CEO LinkedIn page — same audience, same voice, same relationship-building instinct as the community itself

- Scope may expand over time to include The Breakout CEO LinkedIn page more broadly, including coordination on post finalization and scheduling, as the team evolves



Possible Role Expansion

- As the podcast community stabilizes, this role will assist the Marketing Ops Lead in scoping and eventually launching a law firm community and supporting community-facing elements of the Breakout CEO Awards program. Neither is a current priority.

- LinkedIn responsibilities may also grow as the team evolves, potentially including broader involvement in social content finalization and distribution for the podcast brand.



What You Won't Own (other tea
mbers handle these responsibilities)

- Law firm blog or law firm newsletter 

- Podcast production, editing, or episode publication

- GHL, 
, or marketing automation 

- Podcast guest pipeline outreach and booking



Experience with Circle is a strong advantage. Familiarity with dedicated community platforms (Slack, Skool, etc.) is acceptable if you haven't used Circle specifically.



Who We're Looking For

**Must have:**

- Demonstrated community growth — not just management, but documented member growth and engagement results

- Ability to work independently without daily direction; client testimony or portfolio evidence required

- Strong enough writing to own the podcast newsletter independently — clear, direct, and credible for a professional founder audience

- Understands community as a business function, not just a gathering place

- Can adapt voice and engagement style to startup founders and scaling CEOs



This role is inherently relationship-driven work. You genuinely enjoy facilitating other people's conversations — not just broadcasting content. You find meaning in member connections and community health, not just follower counts. You're warm, consistent, and patient. If community work feels draining rather than energizing, this isn't the right fit.

Preferred

- Experience with B2B, professional services, or founder-facing communities

- Platform experience with Circle, Slack, or other dedicated community tools

- Podcast community experience

- Familiarity with community-to-pipeline connection (how community members become clients or referrals)



**This role is not a fit if:**

- Your entire portfolio is consumer wellness, coaching, or MLM-adjacent communities with no evidence of B2B adaptation

- You frame community as "creating a safe space" rather than driving business outcomes

- You can't produce specific engagement or growth metrics from past work

- You require constant content direction from the principal



The Audience Test

Our community members are startup founders and scaling CEOs navigating pivotal 
nts in their businesses. The tone that works for a coaching community, a wellness brand, or a consumer audience will not work here. Every candidate must pass a short writing test before any interview is scheduled.



*Draft a brief three-paragraph newsletter intro for a podcast that features candid conversations with scaling CEOs navigating pivotal 
nts in their businesses. Topic: CEOs who are navigating pivotal decisions usually align with a "Breakout Arc" that includes the following stages: Building traction, something Breaks and disrupts the 
ntum, new perspectives and actions lead to a Breakout 
nt, the business achieves a new breakthrough trajectory



Use whatever tools you want, including AI. Your job is to make sure the final result sounds nothing like AI (e.g., no generic openers, no motivational filler, no hedged corporate phrasing, no bullet-pointed "key takeaways.") It should read like a sharp, specific human wrote it for our specific audience.



What we're evaluating: Does the voice fit founders making high-stakes decisions? Is it clear, direct, and earned? Or does it sound like it came from a template? The writing doesn't need to be perfect. It needs to show the right instincts and the judgment to know what "right" sounds like for this audience.



**Submit the writing test with your application. Applications without it will not be reviewed.**



To Apply



Submit the following:

1. Your writing test (see above — required)

2. A brief overview of 1–2 communities you've built or grown, with specific results (member count growth, engagement metrics, outcomes); make sure to emphasize the building, as we need to launch our community

3. Any relevant portfolio links or client testimonials



**Applications without the writing test will not be reviewed.**

mbers

, VRBO, Agoda, Expedia or short-term-let experience

Strong problem-solving ability

Clear communication

Strong organisation and time management

SOPs are followed and improved

You identify problems before being told

, VRBO, Agoda, Expedia or short-term-let experience.

You start the day with 15 planned tasks.

 what gets done today and what gets pushed back?

title: Video Editor
description:
Video Editor Needed: Multi-Source Tutorial Video (Tech/XR YouTube Channel)



Job Type: Project-based (potential for ongoing work if it's a good fit)

Pay: Per-project flat rate (quoted after reviewing your portfolio and the project scope)

Location: Remote, work from home



About the Channel



I run Himels Tech, a YouTube channel covering Apple Vision Pro, spatial computing, sim racing, and AI/XR tools. We're at over 20,000 subscribers with 8 million lifetime views on YouTube, and around 15 million across all platforms. Average view duration runs well above industry norm, so retention and pacing matter a lot on this channel.



The Project



I'm working on a tutorial-style video for an upcoming collaboration with Higgsfield AI. The edit will combine:



Webcam footage with audio (my on-camera narration)

Multiple additional video sources (B-roll and/or a second camera angle)

Screen recording footage (software walkthrough)



I need someone who can sync all of this cleanly, cut it into a tight, engaging tutorial, and make it feel professional, not like a stitched-together screen capture.



Responsibilities



Sync audio and video across multiple sources (webcam, screen recording, additional cameras)

Edit into a polished tutorial format: clear pacing, clean cuts, no dead air

Add captions, text callouts, and zoom/highlight effects on screen recording sections where useful

Light color correction and audio leveling across sources

Deliver a project file or clearly organized export settings so revisions are easy

Turn around a first cut within an agreed timeframe (we'll set this per project)



Requirements



Proven experience editing multi-camera or multi-source videos (please share 2 to 3 examples, ideally tutorial or tech content)

Comfortable working with screen recording footage specifically (this is not just talking-head editing)

Strong sense of pacing for YouTube retention, not just technically correct cuts

Reliable communication and ability to take short, direct feedback and revise quickly

Familiarity with CapCut is a plus but not required. Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut are all fine



Nice to Have



Interest in or familiarity with tech, gadgets, VR/AR, or gaming content

Experience editing sponsored or branded content



How to Apply



Please start your application with the word "TUTORIAL" so I know you read the full post. Include:



Your rate for a project like this (flat rate per video)

2 to 3 links to edited work, ideally something with multiple video sources or screen recording

Your typical turnaround time for a first cut



This is starting as a one-off project, but if it's a great fit, there's real potential for ongoing work editing future videos.

Your ability to listen, empathize, and clearly explain our services will directly lead to booked jobs and happy customers.



Key Responsibilities:



Handle a high volume of inbound customer calls in a professional and friendly manner.



Clearly explain our junk removal services, pricing model, and process to potential customers.



Ask the right questions to understand the customer's specific needs (e.g., type of junk, location, access).



Accurately input booking details into our scheduling software.



Follow up with customers via

What We're Looking For (Requirements):



EXCELLENT English Communication Skills: Clear, professional, and confident phone voice. Neutral accent is preferred.



Proven Experience: At least 1-2 years of experience in a customer service, phone-based, or sales role. Experience in a service industry (like home services) is a big plus.



Tech-Savvy: Comfortable using CRM software, scheduling tools, and Google Workspace (Gmail, Sheets, etc.). Ability to learn new platforms quickly.



Strong Active Listener: You can understand a customer's needs without them having to repeat themselves.



Problem-Solver: You can think on your feet, answer unexpected questions, and overcome objections to book the job.



Reliable & Professional: A stable, quiet home office setup with a high-speed internet connection and a quality headset.



Availability: Must be willing to work during US/Canada Eastern or Pacific Time business hours (e.g., 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM EST, which is 9:00 PM - 6:00 AM PHT, or similar). Specific schedule will be discussed.



What We Offer:



Competitive base salary with a performance-based bonus structure (earn more for every job you book!).



Permanent, full-time work-from-home setup.



Comprehensive training on our services and systems.



Opportunities for growth and advancement as our team expands.



A supportive and respectful management team.



Consistent schedule and predictable workload.



How to Apply:

Ready to help people clear out their clutter? Please send your updated resume/CV and a 2-3 minute voice recording answering the following questions:



"Tell me about yourself and why you'd be great for this role."



"How would you handle a caller who is hesitant about the price?"

title: Senior Lifestyle Manager for an AI company

asures themselves against. Someone who has done this work at a senior level, knows what great looks like from the inside, and is ready to build something.



About the Company:

We run an AI-native lifestyle management platform for the world's most demanding clients — founders, athletes, family offices, and high-net-worth individuals who expect their personal and professional lives to run without friction.



Our members do not manage logistics. We do. Across travel, dining, private experiences, luxury goods, and wellness — everything is handled, anticipated, and elevated by a team that operates at the highest level of personal service.



We have built the content operations side of this business. Now we are scaling the member experience function, and we need a Lead Lifestyle Manager to be the first senior hire in that team.





The Role

On the member side, you are managing a live queue of requests across multiple members simultaneously. Elevating confirmed plans, securing access that others cannot get, building partner relationships that make the impossible routine. The pace is high. The standard is higher.



On the leadership side, you are the benchmark. As the team scales, you will bring new Lifestyle Managers up to speed, review their work, and hold the quality line on every member interaction that goes out.

Benefits

* Wellbeing stipend



Working Hours

* Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time (EST)

* Full-time only (40 hours per week)

Core Responsibilities

* Triage and manage a high-volume live queue across dining, experiences, wellness, and luxury goods simultaneously, at a pace.

* Elevate confirmed plans before members ask. Personal touches, upgraded access, and proactive picks that show you actually know them.

* Make outbound calls to hotels, restaurants, and venues globally to secure what others can't, and build the relationships that make that repeatable.

* Communicate with members and partners with precision and warmth. Right detail, right tone, right 
nt.

* Use our Claude-powered AI platform to research and build offers fast, applying your own judgment before anything reaches a member.

* Document every preference, interaction, and partner note so the next person picking up a request knows exactly where things stand.



Team Leadership

* Own the quality bar for everything the team sends out and hold it without being asked.

* Onboard and upskill incoming Lifestyle Managers, transferring your instincts and standards to the people behind you.

* Review work, give direct feedback, and flag problems to leadership before they become issues.



You're Perfect for This Role If You

* Have 5+ years serving wealthy or high-profile principals in a senior client-facing role — five-star guest experience, principal-level EA, luxury concierge, or equivalent  where the margin for error was zero.

* Have led or mentored a team before, formally or not, and understand what it means to be accountable for someone else's output.

* Speak and write English at a native level. Polished enough for a member message and direct enough for a cold call to a London hotel manager.

* Pick up the phone first, know who to ask for, and never let "fully booked" be the end of the conversation.

* Notice what members need before they say it, not through research, but through the pattern recognition that comes from years of real client proximity.

* Have worked in high-volume, high-pressure environments where everything is urgent and you recalibrate rather than freeze.

* Handle confidential client information and NDA-bound relationships as a matter of course.

* Are professional and composed by default. Warm with members, direct with partners, serious when it counts.



Nice to Have

* First-hand personal knowledge of luxury properties, restaurants, and experiences in London, New York, Paris, Dubai, Tokyo, or Singapore.

* An existing network of contacts at high-end hotels, restaurants, or lifestyle providers built through years of relationship work.

* Experience moving between an individual contributor role and a team leadership role — comfortable doing the work and directing others doing it.

* Familiarity with AI tools as part of a daily professional workflow.

title: Appointment Setter
description:
We Are Drowning in Leads. We Need Someone Who Can Save Them.



At Nested Housing, we are growing fast and we have a problem most companies would kill for. Qualified prospects are coming in and we do not have enough hands to nurture them the right way. Every unconverted lead is a person we failed to help. We are not okay with that.

We are looking for one person who is ambitious, disciplined, and ready to join a community that will push them to the extremes as a full time Appointment Setter.



Who We Are



Nested Housing is a co-hosting and short term rental company built on one non-negotiable principle: every person who interacts with us leaves better than when they arrived. Whether they become a client or not. That is the standard in how we operate every single day.

We are not just a business, we are a team of people who genuinely care about each other, our clients, and the long term vision we are building together. We invest in our people the way we invest in our business because the vision isn't just a number, but rather an impact.



Our values are simple:



- Value first, ALWAYS

- Community and team culture

- Long term growth and vision

- Integrity over everything

- Results are driven by action, not words



If those words do not light something up in you, this is not for you.



The Problem You Will Solve



Right now our closing team is waiting on qualified appointments that are not coming in fast enough. Cold leads are sitting untouched. Follow ups are being missed. Rapport is not being built. And every day that passes without someone in this role is a day we leave money, impact, and relationships on the table.

You are the solution to that problem. You are the first voice, the first impression, and the first relationship a prospect has with Nested Housing. When you do your job at the highest level, our closers close, our business scales, and our mission reaches more people.

That is the impact of this role. It is not small.



What We Need From You

We hire for the trifecta. Skill can be taught. These cannot:



Capacity: You are someone who grows constantly. You do not wait to be coached. You analyze your own conversations, identify your own gaps, build your own resources, and bring them back to the team. You have the capacity to take on more responsibility over time and you genuinely want to.



Character: You do the right thing when no one is watching. You are honest with prospects even when the truth is uncomfortable. You would never sell someone on something you do not genuinely believe will help them. Your word means something and your actions prove it.



Motivation: You are not here for a paycheck. You are here because you want to build something, prove something, and become someone. You are competitive, obsessed with improvement, and the kind of person whose work ethic shows up in every area of their life.



What the Role Actually Looks Like



- High volume outbound cold outreach across multiple channels

- Vetting, qualifying, and nurturing leads with genuine care

- Booking qualified appointments for our closing team

- Tracking all outcomes in Google Sheets and Notion pipeline

- Analyzing conversations and building team resources from what you learn

- Attending mandatory team calls, accountability sessions, and 1 on 1s

- Filling EOD and EOW reports without exception

- Showing up at 8AM and being reachable through 5PM (EST)



This is a full time role. It is your only job. We are not your side hustle and you are not ours.



This Is Not For You If:



- You are motivated purely by money with no deeper purpose

- You externalize blame when things go wrong

- You cannot take feedback or think your way is the only way

- Your actions do not match your words

- You are looking for something flexible to fit around other commitments





Where This Goes

We promote from within. Every single time.



The path is real: Setter —> Lead Setter —> Closer —> Acquisitions Manager

What we are building isn't a temporary business. It's a permanent impact that will drive you to your long term vision. The culture, the relationships, and the experiences we will both gain from this partnership will leave a lifelong impact.



Compensation is performance based and tiered. The better you perform, the more you earn. Details will be discussed during the interview process.



How to Apply

Click the link below to submit your application. Incomplete applications will not be considered.
