title: CONTROLLER FOR US FRACTIONAL CFO FIRM (FULL TIME, MULTI-ENTITY, PE-BACKED CLIENTS)
description:
Stack Growth Solutions is a US fractional CFO firm serving private equity and private credit backed companies. We build finance functions for multi-entity businesses from scratch: monthly close, consolidation, budgeting, lender reporting, and the systems behind them. We are hiring a full time Controller to run engagements for client books directly, while working with the firm's owner.



10-25 hrs / week to start. Full time within 6 months. 



This is not an easy role and the pay rate reflects that. We want someone who has the past experience of successfully completing tough challenges in similar roles. Our clients are growing companies with stale or missing finance infrastructure. You will work with owner to redesign and build the close process, the budget, and the accounting systems. You will then take the lead in running those functions day to day. You will work closely with firm leadership and client leadership on system design, business operations, and workflow, but you are expected to drive the build, spot what is broken, and propose the fix without being asked. You must also be a strong communicator as you will be discussing strategic plans with the CFO firm owner and clients directly.



You will own:

- Designing and standing up accounting systems, processes, and controls from scratch for multi-entity groups

- The monthly close calendar for a nine-entity roll-up, from checklist through reviewed financials

- Full-cycle accounting oversight: billing, receivables, payables, payroll review, work in progress, accruals, intercompany, cutoff

- Review of client bookkeepers' work against a defined standard

- Book cleanup and chart of accounts standardization to audit-ready quality

- Building annual budgets and supporting forecasting in FP&A software (Fathom, Jirav, or similar)

- Lender reporting preparation and consolidation support (QuickBooks and Intuit Enterprise Suite, Fathom)

- Streamlining accounting and operational workflows, and documenting SOPs as you build, in our templates



The bar:

- 5+ years in accounting with full-cycle ownership: you have personally owned everything from billing and AR/AP through close and reporting, not one slice of it

- At least 2 years owning a monthly close end to end

- You have built accounting processes or systems from scratch at least once: new entity, new ERP, post-acquisition cleanup, or a company that had nothing

- Multi-entity and intercompany experience required; roll-up, PE-backed, construction or field services (WIP, job costing), or public accounting background strongly preferred

- Budget buildout experience required; Fathom or Jirav exposure strongly preferred

- US GAAP fluency; QuickBooks Online expert; strong with technology generally and quick to learn new tools

- Written English clean enough to go to a US CEO without editing

- At least 6 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern time



How we work: everything is reviewed, everything is documented, and our deadlines are lender deadlines. Numbers that are close are wrong. If your work regularly needs a second pass, or you wait to be told what to build, this is not the right seat.



Process: application, one interview, paid test assignment on a real close scenario. Begin your application with the word LEDGER so we know you read this.



To apply, answer the following in your cover letter. Answers without specifics will not be considered.

- In your most recent close role: how many entities, how many business days to close, and what single item most often delayed it? What did you change to fix it?

- Describe a time you built an accounting process or system from scratch: what existed before, what you built, what tools you used, and how long it took to run reliably without you touching it.

- Describe an intercompany or multi-entity mess you personally untangled: the cause, how you found it, the fix, and what you put in place so it never came back.

- What share of your work has been reviewing others' work versus preparing your own? Describe a material error you caught in review that the preparer insisted was correct.

- In five sentences or fewer, explain to a non-financial CEO why his June financials changed after he already reviewed them. Write it as if you were sending it.

- Your expected monthly salary for full time work, and your working hours in US Eastern time.

title: AI Integration and Automation Engineer (APIs, n8n, Claude Code, Data Pipelines)
description:
AI Integration and Automation Engineer (APIs, n8n, Claude Code, Data Pipelines)



Stack Growth Solutions builds modern finance back offices for private equity backed companies. We are hiring an engineer to design and build the integration and AI layer across our clients: data pipelines between accounting, payroll, operations, and reporting systems, plus AI agents and automations that run real business processes. You will work directly with the firm's owner.



This is not an easy role and the pay rate reflects that. We want someone who has built serious, production-grade automation in demanding environments. Our clients are companies being upgraded from the ground up. The systems you build replace spreadsheets,
 chains, and manual work, and they have to run reliably without you watching them. You will work closely with the firm's owner and client leadership on system design, business workflow, and operations, but we are hiring someone with an entrepreneurial mindset: you study how a business actually runs, map how data should flow through it, see where the process is broken, and design the system that fixes it. You will not be handed a complete spec every time. You must also be a strong communicator, as you will be discussing designs and workflows with the owner and clients directly.



You will own:

- Designing how data flows across each client's stack: accounting, payroll, field operations, CRM, reporting, and project tools, regardless of which specific software sits at each node

- Building and maintaining integrations via APIs, webhooks, middleware (n8n, Make, Zapier), and custom code where connectors do not exist

- Advanced AI implementation: Claude Code, agents, structured LLM workflows, and tool-connected automations embedded in accounting and back office processes, built with validation and human oversight so they are dependable

- ETL-style work: extracting, cleaning, transforming, and syncing data between systems so reporting is built on reliable data

- Workspace and board buildouts in tools like 
 and Notion; we consider this baseline work you should find trivial – should utilize Claude connectors to streamline this work

- Hardening one-off builds into reusable templates and playbooks we deploy across clients



The bar:

- 3+ years building automations and integrations in production, with n8n, Make, Zapier, or code, and role where you had accountability as these broke

- Strong API engineering: REST, webhooks, OAuth and key auth, JSON, pagination, rate limits, retries, and error handling; you read documentation without being walked through it

- Real data engineering instincts: you think in sources, transformations, and destinations, and you can explain how you keep two systems in sync without silent drift

- Advanced hands-on LLM work: Claude Code, agents, structured outputs, or tool-connected workflows in production; a chatbot demo does not qualify

- Scripting ability (Python or JavaScript) for the gaps middleware cannot cover

- You can map a messy real-world process nobody documented, ask sharp questions early, and turn it into a system without supervision

- Self-motivated and comfortable with ambiguity; you propose the design rather than wait for one

- At least 6 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern time



Finance or accounting context is a plus, not a requirement. We supply the accounting judgment; you supply the architecture and flawless execution.



Process: application, live portfolio walkthrough, paid test project. We hand you a spec for a system we have already built and see how close you get in a week. Begin your application with the word PIPELINE.



To apply, answer the following in your cover letter. Answers without specifics will not be considered.

- Describe the most complex integration or automation system you have built end to end: the systems involved, how data flowed between them, what broke most often, and what you would rebuild differently today.

- Describe an integration you built where no native connector existed: which APIs, which auth method, how you handled failures, rate limits, and retries, and how you knew when it silently failed.

- Describe the most advanced LLM-based system you have built that was not a chatbot: what it did, how you made it reliable enough for someone to depend on daily, and what validation or oversight you built around it.

- Two systems both claim to be the source of truth for the same records and they disagree. Walk through how you would design the sync and reconciliation so drift gets caught and escalated.

- Your hourly rate, weekly availability, and working hours in US Eastern time.

We are hiring a part time operations VA to run the day to day operations across all of it. You will work directly with the firm's owner.

 and Notion. During live deals, the pace picks up: diligence request lists, data rooms, document collection, and closing checklists, all with real deadlines. Your job is to make sure the machine actually runs: every task has an owner and a due date, nothing sits stalled without someone knowing, and the owner never has to ask what the status of anything is. We use AI heavily; you will work with Claude daily, and we will train you on our specific setups, but you need to arrive already comfortable using it for real work.



You will own:

- Managing engagement task boards in 
 and Notion: creating recurring monthly accounting tasks, updating statuses, keeping boards accurate and current

- Tracking the monthly close checklist across entities and following up with accounting staff on open and overdue items

- Supporting M&A due diligence and deal closings: maintaining diligence request trackers, organizing data rooms, chasing documents from sellers and advisors, and keeping closing checklists current

- Chasing down missing items: statements, documents, approvals, and responses needed to keep work moving

- Using Claude for day to day work: organizing information, and running the workflows we build for you

- Coordinating scheduling and meeting follow-ups across US time zones

- Genuinely tech-savvy and a fast learner; comfortable working inside task and project systems daily, 
 or Notion strongly preferred

title: Lead Research and Scraping Specialist (Part Time, US Finance Firm, Long Term)
description:
Stack Growth Solutions is a US fractional CFO and advisory firm serving private equity and private credit backed companies. We are hiring a part time lead research and scraping specialist. You will work directly with the firm's owner.



This is a research-heavy seat, not a volume-scraping seat. Our market is small and sophisticated: independent sponsors, search fund acquirers, lower middle market private equity firms, business owners who just closed acquisitions or debt raises, and lenders. Finding them cannot be done with keyword scrapes or purchased lists. It requires reading profiles, deal announcements, and press coverage, understanding private equity vocabulary, and judging whether a person actually closed deals or just talks about them. We will give you a detailed written client profile with qualifiers and disqualifiers. Your job is to apply it with judgment, build clean lead lists with verified contact information, and load each lead into the right outreach campaign. Some leads are worked on LinkedIn, others by
, so every lead needs the right contact channel found. You do not handle replies; all responses route to the owner.



You will own:

- Sourcing leads from LinkedIn, Searchfunder, deal announcements, trade press, press releases, SBA and SBIC data, state filings, and wherever else the signal lives, against our written client profile

- Custom scraping: pulling targeted lists from sources that do not offer clean exports, using whatever combination of tools, scrapers, and manual digging the source requires

- Finding and verifying contact information: work
s, direct LinkedIn profiles, company details, with verification so bounce rates stay low

- Qualifying every lead against explicit disqualifier rules, with the specific signal documented for each one

- Writing two-line personalized openers referencing each lead's specific deal or announcement

- Loading leads into the correct outreach campaign by segment (we will train you on our tools)

- Maintaining the lead tracker so the owner can audit any lead, its source, and its signal in seconds



The bar:

- 2+ years in B2B lead research, list building, or data scraping for US clients

- Proven custom scraping skill: you can pull a clean, structured list from a messy source, and you will be asked to walk through exactly how you have done it

- Strong at contact discovery and
 verification: you know the tools and techniques for finding a verified work
 when it is not listed anywhere obvious

- You can explain, in your own words, what an independent sponsor is, what a search fund is, and what lower middle market private equity means. This will be tested in the interview.

- Excellent written English; your openers go to CEOs and investors without editing

- Meticulous and honest: a lead you cannot justify is a lead you do not submit

- Security-minded: you will work inside accounts we provision, never share access, and sign an NDA

- At least 2 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern time



Process: application, short interview, paid test project. We give you the client profile document and pay for 2 hours: deliver 10-20 STRONG leads with segment assignments, documented signals, verified contact information, and openers. The test is scored on qualification accuracy and contact quality, not volume. Begin your application with the word SIGNAL.



To apply, answer the following in your cover letter. Answers without specifics will not be considered.

- Describe the most difficult lead list you have ever built: the criteria, the sources, how you qualified each lead, and how the client measured quality.

- Describe a custom scrape you built from a source with no clean export: the source, the tools or methods you used, and what the final dataset looked like.

 for a business owner whose

title: Rebates & Bookkeeping Associate
description:
Location: Remote (Philippines)

Hours: Full-time, US time zone



About First Bite



First Bite is a foodservice technology company building the AI-powered go-to-market platform for food manufacturers selling into restaurants, hotels, schools, and hospitals. We have 50+ manufacturer customers, manage $800M+ in foodservice commerce, and have grown 6x since early 2024.



As we scale, we need a sharp, experienced bookkeeper to own two critical back-office functions: monthly company books and our Digital Rebates claim workflow.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



*Monthly bookkeeping & financial close*



- Own the monthly close: reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and Stripe payouts in QuickBooks Online

- Classify and code all transactions across operating accounts; maintain a clean, audit-ready chart of accounts

- Reconcile Stripe gross revenue, fees, refunds, and payouts to QuickBooks deposits

- Manage AP: enter vendor bills, schedule payments, track outstanding invoices

- Manage AR: invoice customers, follow up on aging receivables, reconcile payments

- Prepare monthly P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow snapshots for leadership review and a customer breakdown of overdue invoices for account managers

- Support quarterly reviews with our external accountant and annual tax prep

- Track expense categorization across SaaS subscriptions, payroll, contractors, and travel

- Maintain employee/contractor expense reimbursement workflow



*Rebate claim processing & validation*



First Bite processes thousands of operator rebate claims per quarter through our Digital Rebates product. Each claim comes with an operator-submitted invoice, and a meaningful share have issues — wrong distributor, mismatched SKUs, dates outside the offer window, addresses that don't match the operator, possible duplicates. Your job is to validate each claim, use judgment to approve / hold / escalate, and ensure operators get paid within the same week.



- Validate incoming rebate claims against each manufacturer's offer terms (eligible SKUs, date window, geography, allowed distributors)

- Approve clean claims, request additional evidence from operators when something is missing, and escalate suspicious or business-context claims to the First Bite CS or Sales lead on the account

- Communicate directly with operators when needed — brief, professional written-English requests for additional supporting information

- Run weekly payout cycles to operators and reconcile payouts against manufacturer bill-backs (this ties straight into the books)

- Surface patterns across claims that should become validation rules (e.g., distributor X consistently mislabels case counts) and feed them back to the team



*Process improvement & reporting*



- Build and maintain trackers, reconciliation reports, and audit logs

- Identify repetitive work that could be automated and partner with our engineering team to streamline it

- Support ad-hoc finance requests from leadership (board prep, investor updates, customer-level revenue cuts)



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



*Required*



- 5–10 years of bookkeeping experience, with at least 2 years owning monthly close end-to-end at a small/mid-sized company (ideally SaaS or subscription-based)

- QuickBooks Online expertise — not just data entry, but reconciliation and chart of accounts management

- Hands-on experience reconciling Stripe (or similar processor) with the GL — you understand fees, refunds, payout timing, and how it all maps into QBO

- Strong AP/AR workflow experience including vendor management and customer invoicing

- Hands-on experience using LLMs (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini) and/or OCR tools to interact with files, images, and reports

- Strong judgment and a skeptical eye — you can look at an invoice, sense when something is off, and know whether to ask, escalate, or approve

- Comfortable making direct contact with internal stakeholders and external customers in writing; able to ask for clarification without sounding accusatory

- Excellent written English; comfortable communicating with US-based teammates over Slack and

- Sharp attention to detail — invoices and transactions come in dozens of formats and small errors compound quickly



Nice to have



- Prior experience with rebate, trade-spend, chargeback, or claims-validation programs (insurance, healthcare, retail rebates all transfer)

- Experience within the food or distribution industry

- Comfort with building custom reports in tools like Retool, Google Sheets, etc.

title: E-commerce/DTC Video Editor - For Ads (Full Time)
description:
Performance-focused · AI-augmented · Long-term



We run paid media at scale for DTC and e-commerce brands across European markets — and we're looking for an editor who gets the why behind every cut, not just the how.



This isn't a role for someone who waits for a brief and assembles clips. We need someone who can watch raw footage and know instinctively which B-roll makes the hook land — who understands that the wrong cutaway kills a conversion and the right one doubles watch time. If you've ever paused an ad you liked just to reverse-engineer why it worked, keep reading.



The basics





Type: Full-time

Location: Remote

Compensation: 900–1,100 USD/month

Start: ASAP

Output: 3–4 finished edits per day





What you'll own





Edit short-form ad creative for Meta and TikTok — fast, punchy, conversion-oriented

Choose and sequence B-roll with intent — every clip serves the hook, reinforces the claim, or deepens the emotional pull

Build visual hooks that stop the scroll — you know the first 1–2 seconds are the entire game

Cut UGC, founder, and testimonial footage into structured formats (Hook ? Problem ? Mechanism ? CTA)

Generate AI video assets in Higgsfield and similar tools — realistic, on-brand footage that blends seamlessly with real clips

Produce modular assets that repurpose cleanly across placements and audiences





Non-negotiables



Proven DTC/e-commerce ad editing. You've edited ads that actually ran on Meta or TikTok for real brands. You understand pacing curves, attention drop-off, and how to build an edit around a conversion goal — not just aesthetics.



Intentional B-roll selection. You don't fill gaps, you amplify the script. You know when a reaction shot beats a product shot, and when on-screen text does more work than either.



Visual hook creation. You think visually first. You can concept and execute an opening that creates immediate pattern interruption — without leaning on the script to carry it.



Higgsfield + AI fluency. You're already comfortable prompting and generating realistic AI video, and you know how to make Higgsfield output that doesn't read as AI. We provide advanced internal training — but you need a real foundation to build on.



Strong English comprehension. Most scripts and voiceovers are in English. You need to catch nuance, not just words, so your edit rhythm matches what's being said and why.



Comfortable in Notion. We run briefs, trackers, and feedback through Notion. You don't need to be a power user, but you need to work inside it day to day without friction.



Nice to have





VSL or long-form ad formats for cold traffic

Direct response frameworks (AIDA, PAS, and similar)

Other AI video tools beyond Higgsfield (Kling, Runway, Pika)

Working knowledge of Meta ad structure — formats, ratios, placements





Who fits here





You think like a marketer, not just a creative — you care about what converts

You bring ideas and push back on a brief when you see a better angle

You ship final-ready work, not "almost there"

Fast iteration energizes you; it doesn't slow you down

You're driven and you work hard — you take pride in output and don't need to be chased

You want to be part of a team, not a solo freelancer — you communicate, share wins, and lift the people around you

You're honest and loyal — we'd rather hear the hard truth early than a polished excuse late, and we build long-term with people who do the same





What we offer



This is a long-term seat, not a gig. We invest in the people who commit to us:





Access to a premium AI tool stack — HeyGen, Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, and more, all on us, so you're never limited by what you can produce

Advanced internal training on our editing systems, AI workflows, and direct response frameworks — you'll get better at this here than almost anywhere else

A real growth path — clear room to take on more ownership, scope, and responsibility as you prove yourself

A team that values honesty and loyalty — we're direct with each other, we back the people who back us, and we keep the people who grow with us





How to apply



Read this part carefully — applications without a portfolio won't be reviewed.





Portfolio. Link 3–5 ad edits you're proud of. DTC/e-commerce strongly preferred. If something ran and performed, tell us the result.

Your workflow. Walk us through how you go from brief to final cut. What do you ask for? What do you need? How do you handle unclear direction?

Your AI work. Include at least one example where you generated or integrated AI video. Higgsfield examples are a bonus.

Logistics. Your availability and timezone.





The trial task



This role comes with a paid-style trial task — and it's where you really win it. If you're hungry for this, don't wait to be asked: complete it, edit the result, and send it in with your application.



Trial task:

If the edit is strong, we'll hire you on the spot. This is your chance to show us — not tell us — that you're the editor we're describing.

We run paid media at scale for DTC and e-commerce brands across European markets — and we're looking for an editor who gets the why behind every cut, not just the how.



This isn't a role for someone who waits for a brief and assembles clips. We need someone who can watch raw footage and know instinctively which B-roll makes the hook land — who understands that the wrong cutaway kills a conversion and the right one doubles watch time. If you've ever paused an ad you liked just to reverse-engineer why it worked, keep reading.



The basics





Type: Full-time

Location: Remote

Compensation: 900–1,100 USD/month

Start: ASAP

Output: 3–4 finished edits per day





What you'll own





Edit short-form ad creative for Meta and TikTok — fast, punchy, conversion-oriented

Choose and sequence B-roll with intent — every clip serves the hook, reinforces the claim, or deepens the emotional pull

Build visual hooks that stop the scroll — you know the first 1–2 seconds are the entire game

Cut UGC, founder, and testimonial footage into structured formats (Hook ? Problem ? Mechanism ? CTA)

Generate AI video assets in Higgsfield and similar tools — realistic, on-brand footage that blends seamlessly with real clips

Produce modular assets that repurpose cleanly across placements and audiences





Non-negotiables



Proven DTC/e-commerce ad editing. You've edited ads that actually ran on Meta or TikTok for real brands. You understand pacing curves, attention drop-off, and how to build an edit around a conversion goal — not just aesthetics.



Intentional B-roll selection. You don't fill gaps, you amplify the script. You know when a reaction shot beats a product shot, and when on-screen text does more work than either.



Visual hook creation. You think visually first. You can concept and execute an opening that creates immediate pattern interruption — without leaning on the script to carry it.



Higgsfield + AI fluency. You're already comfortable prompting and generating realistic AI video, and you know how to make Higgsfield output that doesn't read as AI. We provide advanced internal training — but you need a real foundation to build on.

Direct response frameworks (AIDA, PAS, and similar)

Other AI video tools beyond Higgsfield (Kling, Runway, Pika)

Working knowledge of Meta ad structure — formats, ratios, placements





Who fits here

Fast iteration energizes you; it doesn't slow you down

You want to be part of a team, not a solo freelancer — you communicate, share wins, and lift the people around you

You're honest and loyal — we'd rather hear the hard truth early than a polished excuse late, and we build long-term with people who do the same





What we offer



This is a long-term seat, not a gig. We invest in the people who commit to us:





Access to a premium AI tool stack — HeyGen, Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, and more, all on us, so you're never limited by what you can produce

Advanced internal training on our editing systems, AI workflows, and direct response frameworks — you'll get better at this here than almost anywhere else

A real growth path — clear room to take on more ownership, scope, and responsibility as you prove yourself

A team that values honesty and loyalty — we're direct with each other, we back the people who back us, and we keep the people who grow with us





How to apply



Read this part carefully — applications without a portfolio won't be reviewed.

Your workflow. Walk us through how you go from brief to final cut. What do you ask for? What do you need? How do you handle unclear direction?

title: Video Editor | D2C Performance Ad Creative for Meta Ads
description:
UGC Video Editor | Performance Ad Creative for Meta Ads



Remote | Full-Time Contractor | Long-Term Role | Fast-Paced Agency



We are Dominate Next, a performance marketing agency based in Scotland. We help direct-to-consumer ecommerce brands across the UK, US and Australia scale through Meta ads and performance creative.



We are hiring a UGC Video Editor who can turn raw creator footage into scroll-stopping ads that convert.



This is not a “make it pretty” role. This is not a cinematic editing role. This is not a YouTube or podcast editing role.



This role is about pacing, clarity, rhythm, retention and making ads feel native to TikTok, Reels and Meta feeds while still driving action.



You will work closely with our creative strategy team, who will provide briefs, raw creator footage, examples, hooks, angles and direction. Your job is to turn that into strong short-form ads that can be tested in real Meta ad accounts.



What you will do

- Edit short-form 
 ads for
 and Instagram.

- Create around 15 short-form videos per week.

- Build multiple versions quickly using different hooks, pacing, clips, and structures.

- Add native-feeling captions, on-screen text, simple motion, sound design and light effects.

- Improve raw creator footage so the final ad feels sharp, clear and engaging.

- Keep edits aligned to the creative brief and client brand guidelines.

- Take feedback quickly and make revisions without ego.

- Repurpose strong footage into new variations and angles.

- Work closely with our creative strategists, designers and paid social team.



What we need from you



Must-haves

- Very proficient in CapCut. This is our preferred editing workflow.

- Strong understanding of UGC, Reels, and paid social ad editing.

- Strong sense of rhythm, flow, pacing and retention.

- Sharp attention to detail, especially captions, cuts, framing, audio levelling and spelling.

- Strong written English.

- At least 1 year of experience editing D2C UGC and paid social ads.

- Reliable and fast internet connection.

- Able to follow a brief closely while still bringing your own editing judgement.



Big plus

- You have edited direct-response ecommerce ads for Meta.

- You understand performance creative basics.

- You know how to make the first 3 seconds stronger.

- You can identify when a video feels too slow, too scripted or too polished.

- You can repurpose one piece of footage into several different ad variations.

- You have experience with beauty, wellness, food, drink, home, lifestyle or supplement brands.

- You have basic knowledge of motion graphics and AI.



This role is probably right for you if

- You enjoy editing short-form ads that are designed to perform.

- You understand that a good ad needs more than clean visuals.

- You care about pacing, hooks, clarity and viewer retention.

- You can take feedback and improve quickly.

- You like working in a fast-paced creative team.

- You want a stable, long-term role where your edits are tested in live ad accounts.



This role is probably not right for you if

- You mainly edit YouTube videos, podcasts or cinematic reels.

- You only want to make aesthetic lifestyle videos.

- You do not have examples of UGC, TikTok, Reels, or paid social ad edits.

- You struggle with captions, spelling or written English.

- You need very detailed instructions for every small edit.

- You do not like fast feedback or revisions.

- You are not interested in e-commerce, Meta ads, or direct response creative.



Working setup

- Full-time remote contractor role.

- 37.5 hours per week.

- Long-term position if you perform well.

- You will have some overlap with UK working hours.

- You will be part of a small, high-performance creative team.

- You will receive direct feedback and clear creative standards.

- You will invoice us monthly as an independent contractor. You are responsible for your own tax and BIR registration in the Philippines.



Pay

- $700 to $800 USD per month depending on experience, speed and quality.



How to apply - Applications that do not follow this will be ignored.



Please include:

- Your portfolio with your best UGC, TikTok, Reels or paid social ad edits.

- A short introduction (Loom video or equivalent) explaining your editing experience.

- Your internet speed test.

- Answers to the application questions below.

- Add the word “TARTAN” at the end of your application so we know you read the full post.



Do not send generic reels, cinematic edits, YouTube videos, podcasts or long-form work unless you also include paid social or UGC ad examples.



If you do not have UGC / performance ad samples, this is not the right role.



Questions to answer in your application

1. How long have you been editing short-form videos, UGC or paid social ads?

2. What editing software do you use?

3. Send 3 examples of short-form ads or UGC videos you edited. For each one, briefly explain what your role was.

4. What makes a UGC ad feel native to TikTok or Reels instead of looking like a polished brand ad?

5. If a video feels slow in the first 5 seconds, what are 3 things you could do to improve it?

6. Are you comfortable creating multiple variations from the same raw footage?

7. Are you comfortable working with UK overlap?



If you want a stable, long-term editing role where your work gets tested in real ad accounts and you can level up quickly, we would love to hear from you.

We are Dominate Next, a performance marketing agency based in Scotland. We help direct-to-consumer ecommerce brands across the UK, US and Australia scale through Meta ads and performance creative.



We are hiring an Associate Creative Strategist to support our creative strategy team across ecommerce clients.

title: Executive Operations & AI Assistant (UK Hours — Night Shift)
description:
EXECUTIVE OPERATIONS & AI ASSISTANT — UK HOURS — PHP 60,000-75,000/MONTH

Remote contractor | ~37-40 hours/week | UK-hours night schedule | 90-day paid trial | Echoverse Collective Limited



This is not a normal VA role. Read the whole ad before applying. Begin your written answers with the phrase COMPLETER-FINISHER so I know you did.



WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH



One Principal: a senior operator (MD/Partner level) at a Big 4 professional services firm, and founder of Echoverse Collective Limited, an AI-native media and intelligence startup. He is neurodivergent, runs multiple parallel workstreams, and is building an AI agent operating system around his life and businesses. Your job is to run the human edge of it: flawless personal administration first, then increasingly the operation of AI agents and automations.



The long-term vision for this role has a name: Chief Human, EVC Operations.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN FROM DAY ONE



- Personal financial admin: invoices, bills, renewals, subscriptions (you'll prepare and run approved payment queues; the Principal retains banking credentials and 2FA)

-
: bring inboxes to organised order — subscriptions, repeat prescriptions and appointment tracking, family logistics, school dates

- Household logistics: home and car insurance, utilities, suppliers

- Travel research and booking

- A daily dashboard and weekly reset — you'll propose the platform

- Documentation of everything: every recurring task becomes a written SOP



WHERE THE ROLE GROWS



- Operating a personal AI operating system: prompting, monitoring agents, triggering workflows, checking outputs

- Building automations in n8n, Zapier, or Relay around ChatGPT and Claude (including Slack with Claude agents)

- Startup operations at Echoverse Collective: compliance calendar, supplier and accountant coordination, investor admin



HOURS — READ THIS CAREFULLY



Your working life runs on UK time. The Principal's contact windows are UK 6:30-9:00am and 8:00pm-1:00am. In Philippine time:



- Core live shift: 3:00-8:00am PH (his evening) — at your desk, responses within 5 minutes (pre-agreed breaks excepted)

- Second live block: 1:30-4:00pm PH (his morning)

- Async work in between, self-scheduled (times shift by an hour in UK winter)



The realistic shape of your life: awake roughly 1:00am-5:00pm PH, asleep in the PH evening. It is one consolidated night schedule — not split sleep — and it only works for people who genuinely prefer living on nights. Many strong candidates already work US or UK graveyard shifts and like them. If that is not you, this role will make you miserable, and we will both find out within 90 days.



Reliable pickup during the live blocks is the single most important feature of this role — the standard is a response within 5 minutes. A short check-in window on Saturday and Sunday is strongly preferred; any regular weekend pattern is agreed up front and written into the offer.



PAY



PHP 60,000-75,000/month depending on capability — deliberately top-of-market for this profile. Band placement is simple: excellent EA discipline, clear communication, and credible schedule fit get you into the band; demonstrated automation and AI-agent capability moves you toward the top. On top of salary:



- Two weeks' bonus at 3 months if confirmed after the trial

- Three months' bonus at 12 months if still employed

- 5% annual pay increase

- 90-day trial period, paid at the full agreed rate from day one



WHO THRIVES HERE



- An experienced EA or administrator with real follow-through. A completer-finisher. This is the pass/fail bar — AI skills do not substitute for it.

- Confident with ChatGPT or Claude. Automation experience (n8n, Zapier, Relay, Make) is a strong advantage, not mandatory.

- Exceptional written English and communication.

- Comfortable with ambiguity: inputs arrive as WhatsApp messages, forwarded
s, and screenshots — not neat task lists. Part of your job is designing the capture system.

- Discreet. You will handle sensitive personal, family, medical, and financial information under written data-handling rules. NDA and data agreement required before the work sample. No subcontracting, ever.



DO NOT APPLY IF: you need every task fully specified; you juggle many clients; you're a content creator first and administrator second; or you dislike building systems and writing things down.



WHAT YOU'LL LEARN



How a senior Big 4 operator manages competing demands. How a startup actually runs: investors, compliance, suppliers. How AI agents are used practically — prompted, monitored, improved — and turned into real operating leverage. This is a rare, high-trust seat next to someone building across corporate, venture, and AI.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph. Put your written answers directly in your application message, and include links to your video and transcript (Google Drive, Loom, or unlisted YouTube — check that link sharing is switched on before you send).



1. A 2-4 minute video introduction, with a transcript. A simple phone recording is fine. We do not assess appearance, accent, background, or camera quality — only clarity, judgement, and whether you understood this ad. I guarantee I will watch the first 60 seconds of every single video. Whether I watch beyond that depends on your communication quality and how well you show you understood the role.



2. Written answers (start with COMPLETER-FINISHER):

(a) Which platform would you run the Principal's daily dashboard on, and why?

(b) Describe a system or SOP you built that outlived you.

(c) Your honest experience with AI tools — including what you can't do yet.

(d) Describe your current sleep and shift pattern, and confirm — honestly — that you can live the schedule above long-term.

(e) Your expected monthly salary in PHP.

(f) Your current client commitments, if any.

(g) Your equipment, backup internet, and backup power setup.



Shortlisted candidates complete a PAID work sample (NDA first), then a live interview, then a paid one-week live trial before the 90-day trial begins.

title: FT Content Strategist/Social Media Manager
description:
We are hiring a full-time Content Strategist + Social Media Manager to help drive growth and revenue across Instagram,
, and TikTok.



This is not an entry-level social media role, and it is not a “just keep the content calendar full” position.



We are looking for someone who has already helped brands grow and monetize through short vertical video, can clearly explain how they did it, and can step into an established personal brand with both strategy and execution skills.



About the Brand



Keenya Kelly is a video marketing and monetization strategist with a large established audience across TikTok, Instagram, and
. We teach entrepreneurs how to grow through short vertical video and turn their content into consistent income.



Our business includes:



low-ticket offers and live challenges

webinars and launch campaigns

a membership

a flagship course and higher-ticket offers



We are a systems-driven team with clear processes, deadlines, and communication standards. We move fast, especially during launch periods, and we are looking for someone who can keep up, think strategically, and execute without needing constant direction.



What This Role Actually Is



This role sits at the intersection of content strategy, conversion strategy, and day-to-day social media execution.



We are not looking for someone who only knows how to post content.

We are looking for someone who understands how to use content to:



grow the right audience

build trust and authority

support active offers

convert attention into leads and sales

create a repeatable content system the team can execute consistently



You should be able to think like a strategist and work like an operator.



What We Are Looking For



You are likely a fit if the following describes you:



1) You have a real content strategy framework



You do not “wing it” or rely on random content ideas.



You have a repeatable process for:



auditing a brand, its audience, and its offers

identifying what content should drive reach vs trust vs conversion

building content pillars and campaign-specific content plans

turning strategy into hooks, scripts, captions, CTAs, and content direction

reviewing performance and adjusting based on what the data says



We are not looking for vague “I help brands show up consistently” language.

We want someone who can clearly explain how you build a content strategy that drives business results.



2) You have proof that your work has driven both growth and revenue



We are looking for someone who has helped brands grow accounts and support monetization.



That means you should be able to show:



accounts you have worked on

what the numbers looked like before you got involved

what changed after your strategy was implemented

how your content supported lead generation, launches, offer sales, or conversions



Views and followers are not enough on their own. We care about business impact.



3) You understand short vertical video deeply



You should have strong working knowledge of:



TikTok

Instagram Reels

 content strategy



You should understand that content cannot simply be reposted everywhere without thought. We want someone who knows how to think strategically about each platform while still creating a cohesive overall brand content system.



4) You can execute what you strategize



This is not a strategy-only role.



You should be comfortable actually doing the work required to move the strategy forward, including:



developing weekly content direction

writing hooks, scripts, captions, and CTAs

organizing and managing content calendars

scheduling and publishing content

adjusting content during launches and promotions

collaborating with the founder and internal team on what gets created next

5) You are highly organized and proactive



We move quickly. You should be someone who:



meets deadlines without being chased

communicates proactively

can work inside structured systems

can keep multiple moving pieces organized during launch periods

is comfortable collaborating with a founder who is also a strategist

What This Role Involves



Your responsibilities will include:



Deep diving into the Keenya Kelly brand, including audience, offers, voice, content pillars, and competitors

Developing a content strategy based on where the brand is going, not just what has been posted before

Delivering weekly content direction for Instagram,
, and TikTok

Creating hooks, script direction, captions, and CTAs tied to active offers

Delivering one Trial Reels concept per day for Instagram

Managing day-to-day content execution on the accounts you are directing

Scheduling and publishing content

Building and maintaining a content system the team can use, including:

competitor tracking

content ideas and hook libraries

campaign content planning

content direction frameworks

Joining bi-weekly strategy calls to review performance and align on the next content cycle

Adapting quickly during active launches, live challenges, webinars, and campaign periods

You Are the Right Fit If…

You have a documented, repeatable process for content strategy

You can show at least 2 examples of accounts you helped grow and monetize

You understand the difference between content for audience growth, authority/trust, and sales

You know how to support a business with multiple offers and live launches

You are comfortable switching between strategy and execution

You can collaborate well with a founder who already understands content strategy

You communicate clearly and do not disappear when things get busy

You are comfortable with deadlines, structure, and accountability

This Is Not the Right Role If…



Please do not apply if any of the following are true:



You are still learning social media strategy and building your process as you go

Your experience is mostly engagement, posting support, or content coordination without measurable strategy results

You cannot clearly explain how your content strategy has supported sales or conversions

You cannot provide proof of accounts you have grown

You only want to strategize and do not want to touch execution

You need to fully own every creative decision in order to do your best work

You struggle with deadlines, communication, or organized systems

How to Apply



To be considered, your application must include the following:



1) A brief breakdown of your content strategy framework



We want to understand how you think and how you work.



Please include:



how you approach a new brand from day one

how you d
 what content is for growth vs trust vs conversion

how you build strategy across Instagram,
, and TikTok

how you measure whether content is working

2) Two or more examples of accounts you have grown and helped monetize



For each example, include:



the brand or account

the platform(s)

what the follower count or performance looked like before you got involved

what strategy you implemented

what changed after

any lead, sales, or revenue results connected to your work

3) Your availability for a full-time role



Please include:



your time zone

your normal working hours

whether you are available to overlap with CST working hours

Important



Applications that are vague, generic, or do not include proof of results will not be reviewed.



We are not looking for someone who simply “loves social media.”

We are looking for someone who knows how to use content to help grow a business.

Type: Full-time / Permanent (probation ? contractor/employee option)



*About us*

Nexus Pass Online helps frequent flyers and travellers obtain expedited border-clearance benefits (NEXUS, Global Entry, TSA PreCheck) and related travel services, and we close sales over the phone and
 from leads generated online. 



*The role (what you’ll do)*

You will join our phone sales team calling warm/hot leads generated by Nexus Pass Online and converting those conversations into paying customers. Day-to-day you will:



- Call warm/hot leads (no cold calling) and close sales over the phone; follow up by
/SMS as needed. 

- Use our CRM and phone system to log activity, update statuses, and follow a structured sales process.

- Build value, uncover needs, handle objections, and confidently close.

- Participate in daily/weekly team huddles, roleplays, and call reviews.

- Hit daily/weekly sales targets and continuously refine your approach through coaching.



*Who we’re looking for (must-haves)*

We want experienced phone closers who are reliable and remote-ready

- 5+ years outbound phone sales experience selling a service (B2C preferred). You must be a phone closer — someone who consistently finishes deals. 

- Excellent spoken & written English — comfortable speaking with North American customers.

- Strong objection-handling and closing skills — confident and persuasive on the phone. 

- Proven remote work discipline: reliable internet, quiet workspace, and punctuality for EST shifts (example expectation for similar remote roles: 11:00 AM–6:00 PM EST). 

- Comfortable using a CRM, phone dialer, Google Workspace, and joining Zoom/Slack for meetings.

- Positive, coachable, team player who is eager for call review feedback and roleplays.



*Training & onboarding*

We provide a structured onboarding program that covers product knowledge, scripts, CRM training, live call listening, role-plays, and ongoing call reviews. New hires shadow experienced closers and move to live calling as they demonstrate readiness. 



*What we offer*

A supportive remote team, regular coaching, and clear opportunities for professional development and advancement.

Ongoing training, call coaching, and a clear path to leadership for high performers.

Daily/Weekly/Monthly Bonuses in addition to your salary. 



*Selection process*

Short-listing of applicants.

Group Zoom session (short intro + Q&A). 

Practical assessment — a short scripted pitch or live pitch to evaluate closing ability.



***How to apply (please follow exactly)***



Please apply on onlinejobs.ph and attach:



Your CV/resume detailing 5+ years of outbound phone sales experience.



Short cover letter with: (a) your recent monthly sales / commission achievements (numbers), (b) confirmation you can work EST hours, (c) whether you have experience selling services and using CRMs, and (d) How many calls per day were you making? What was the talk time?



OPTIONAL but highly recommended: a 1–3 minute voice or video file of you doing a short sales pitch (sell our service in 90 seconds — don’t worry about perfect production; we just want to hear your style). 



Put “REMOTE SALES CLOSER — I CAN CLOSE” in the subject so we know you read this whole ad. If you choose to provide the optional video as above, then use subject: “VIDEO INSIDE - REMOTE SALES CLOSER — I CAN CLOSE”



We’re hiring 6 talented closers now. If you’re a value-based seller who closes with confidence and enjoys phone-driven sales, we’d like to hear from you.

title: PPC Manager (Google & Bing Ads)
description:
Role Overview:

We are seeking an experienced PPC Manager to lead the development, execution, and optimization of paid search campaigns across both Google Ads and Bing Ads. The ideal candidate will have a hands-on understanding of both platforms and proven success managing large-scale, complex campaigns with significant budgets. You will be responsible for delivering results-driven campaigns that align with client goals while maintaining a deep understanding of industry best practices. Previous experience working at Google or a strong insider knowledge of Google Ads best practices is highly advantageous.

As a PPC Manager, you’ll be the go-to expert for all things paid search and will have a direct impact on client performance. The role requires a strategic mindset, data-driven decision-making, and the ability to maintain clear and effective communication with both internal teams and clients.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Paid Search Strategy & Execution:

Campaign Development & Management: Develop, launch, and manage paid search campaigns on Google Ads and Bing Ads, ensuring they are aligned with client objectives and maximize ROI. This includes campaigns on Google Search, Display, YouTube, Shopping, and Bing Search.

Keyword Research & Audience Targeting: Conduct extensive keyword research, competitor analysis, and audience segmentation to identify growth opportunities. Develop comprehensive strategies based on these insights to optimize targeting and bidding.

Campaign Optimization: Continuously analyze and refine campaigns to improve performance metrics such as CPC, CTR, CPA, and ROAS. Implement A/B testing strategies for ad creatives, landing pages, and bidding strategies to maximize conversions.

Ad Copy & Creative Strategy: Work closely with the creative team to ensure that ad copy, creatives, and landing pages are optimized for user engagement and aligned with campaign goals.

2. Client Communication & Consultation:

Client Liaison: Serve as the main point of contact for clients, providing expert consultation on all Google Ads and Bing Ads strategies. Clearly communicate campaign progress, adjustments, and results to ensure client satisfaction and alignment with business objectives.

Performance Reporting: Regularly prepare and present in-depth performance reports, including key performance metrics (CPC, CTR, CPA, ROAS) and actionable insights. Use these reports to showcase campaign successes and provide strategic recommendations for optimization.

Strategic Guidance: Offer strategic recommendations to clients, advising on how to improve campaign performance, expand reach, or address performance challenges. Proactively identify opportunities for growth.

Client Relationship Management: Build and nurture strong relationships with clients, becoming a trusted advisor on paid search and digital marketing. Ensure high levels of client satisfaction, resolve campaign-related issues, and manage client expectations effectively.

3. Budget Management & Performance Tracking:

Budget Oversight: Manage and optimize client budgets across both Google Ads and Bing Ads to ensure campaigns are efficient and within budget. Track and report on budget pacing and ensure that client goals are met while maximizing ROI.

Performance Tracking & Analysis: Utilize Google Analytics, Microsoft Advertising Intelligence, Google Tag Manager, and other analytics platforms to monitor campaign performance in real time. Assess KPIs such as CPC, CTR, CPA, and ROAS to ensure campaigns are delivering results within the defined parameters.

Optimization: Make data-driven decisions to optimize campaigns for better performance. Adjust bids, keywords, targeting, and ads based on performance trends and competitive insights.

4. Collaboration & Cross-Functional Alignment:

Team Collaboration: Work closely with the broader digital marketing team (SEO, Social Media, Creative, Web Development) to ensure that PPC campaigns are integrated into wider marketing and sales strategies. Align campaigns with broader business objectives, ensuring a cohesive approach across all digital channels.

Stakeholder Coordination: Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure paid search efforts align with company goals and support sales or product launch strategies.

Knowledge Sharing: Actively contribute to knowledge-sharing within the marketing team by educating peers about PPC best practices, emerging trends, and new tools or features in Google Ads and Bing Ads.

5. Industry Trend Awareness & Innovation:

Stay Current with PPC Trends: Stay up-to-date with the latest Google Ads and Bing Ads updates, features, and best practices. Attend webinars, conferences, and industry events to keep ahead of emerging trends and leverage new opportunities for clients.

Test New Strategies: Continuously evaluate and experiment with new tools, bidding strategies, and ad formats to ensure campaigns are always optimized and competitive. Propose new strategies to clients based on these findings.

6. Reporting & Data-Driven Insights:

Regular Reporting: Create and maintain regular performance reports, dashboards, and presentations to track campaign progress, analyze performance trends, and showcase ROI. Present these findings in a clear, concise manner to clients and internal teams.

Actionable Insights: Translate complex data into actionable insights that drive campaign improvements. Provide clear, data-backed recommendations to both internal and client stakeholders to guide future PPC strategies and decisions.

Attribution & Conversion Tracking: Implement and manage proper tracking systems to measure campaign effectiveness and provide accurate reporting on conversions, revenue, and other key metrics.



Qualifications:

Education:

Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Certifications in Google Ads and Bing Ads are a plus.



Experience:

Proven PPC Experience: Minimum of 3–5 years of hands-on experience managing PPC campaigns across Google Ads and Bing Ads. This includes experience in Google Search, Display, YouTube, Shopping, and Bing Search campaigns.

Agency or Client Experience: Experience working in a client-facing role, ideally in a digital marketing agency, managing multiple PPC accounts with large-scale budgets.

Experience at Google (Bonus): Previous experience working at Google or within a Google Partner agency is highly desirable, particularly if you have in-depth knowledge of Google Ads best practices, new features, and insights from working directly with the platform.



Technical Skills:

Google Ads & Bing Ads Expertise: Advanced proficiency in managing campaigns across Google Ads and Bing Ads, including search, display, shopping, remarketing, and video campaigns.

Analytics Tools Proficiency: Strong working knowledge of Google Analytics, Microsoft Advertising Intelligence, Google Tag Manager, and other relevant analytics and tracking tools to measure, report, and optimize PPC campaign performance.

Data Interpretation: Ability to analyze large datasets, interpret complex data, and turn insights into actionable strategies to optimize campaign performance.



Soft Skills:

Excellent Communication & Presentation Skills: Ability to explain complex PPC strategies and performance data in a clear, concise, and accessible manner for clients, internal teams, and stakeholders.

Client Management Experience: Proven experience in building and nurturing strong client relationships. Ability to manage client expectations and resolve issues in a timely and professional manner.

Problem-Solving & Proactive Mindset: Strong problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to identifying and addressing campaign issues. Ability to think critically and take strategic action based on data.

Attention to Detail: High attention to detail, ensuring that campaign elements are precise and accurately reflect client objectives, even when working with large volumes of data.



How to Apply:

If you’re an experienced PPC Manager looking for a new challenge, we want to hear from you! Please submit your resume, along with a cover letter outlining your relevant experience here. Include any specific campaigns or achievements that highlight your expertise with Google Ads and Bing Ads.

title: eCommerce Systems Architect / eCommerce Expert
description:
# eCommerce Systems Architect / eCommerce Expert



## Remote | Long-Term | Full-Time or Near Full-Time



## About Us



We are a fast-growing company in the renewable energy industry expanding into nationwide eCommerce. Our goal is to build a professional online store that sells solar materials, solar equipment, complete solar kits, accessories, and training programs to customers across the United States.



We are looking for an experienced eCommerce professional who can help us build the entire operation from the ground up — not just manage product listings.



This role is ideal for someone who understands eCommerce systems, supplier inventory, drop shipping, warehouse inventory, shipping integrations, marketing integrations, and scalable business processes.



---



## Role Overview



We need help setting up and managing a complete eCommerce ecosystem.



Most of our materials will be drop shipped directly from suppliers, but some products will ship from our own warehouse. Because of this, we need someone who can help us establish an inventory system that connects our online store, supplier inventory, warehouse inventory, marketing ecosystem, and 3PL/shipping partners.



We are not just looking for a website designer. We are looking for someone who understands how to build the backend systems that make an eCommerce business run smoothly.



---



## Responsibilities



You will help with:



* Setting up and optimizing our online store

* Recommending the best eCommerce platform if needed

* Building product categories, collections, filters, variants, and product pages

* Organizing solar materials, kits, accessories, and training programs

* Connecting supplier inventory feeds to our store

* Helping create an inventory system from the ground up

* Managing workflows for drop shipped products

* Managing workflows for products shipped from our warehouse

* Connecting the store to a 3PL service for fulfillment and shipping

* Setting up shipping rules, rates, tracking, and fulfillment workflows

* Connecting warehouse inventory with the online store

* Helping establish inventory processes for our internal team

* Connecting the store with our marketing ecosystem

* Integrating the store with CRM,
 marketing, ads, automation tools, and analytics

* Helping set up abandoned cart flows, customer follow-up, and sales automations

* Recommending tools and systems to improve efficiency

* Creating SOPs and documentation for our team

* Helping troubleshoot issues as the system grows

* Continuously improving the customer experience and backend operations



---



## Experience We Are Looking For



The ideal candidate has experience with:



* Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, or similar eCommerce platforms

* Building or managing eCommerce stores

* Supplier inventory integrations

* Drop shipping workflows

* Warehouse inventory systems

* 3PL integrations

* Shipping and fulfillment platforms

* Product catalog organization

* CRM integrations

*
 marketing integrations

* Marketing automation

* API integrations or working with developers who handle API connections

* Google Sheets or Airtable-based inventory workflows

* Process documentation

* Strong English communication

* Strong problem-solving skills



---



## Bonus Experience



Experience with any of the following is a major plus:



* Solar products

* Electrical materials

* Construction materials

* Technical product catalogs

* Shopify apps

* Klaviyo

* Mailchimp

* HubSpot

* GoHighLevel

* Meta Ads

* Google Shopping

* Google Merchant Center

* QuickBooks

* Zapier

* 

* Airtable

* Notion

* Base44

* Gumloop

* AI automation tools

* SEO for eCommerce

* Conversion rate optimization

* Multi-channel selling



---



## What Success Looks Like



A successful person in this role will help us create:



* A professional online store that is clean, easy to use, and built to scale

* A well-organized product catalog

* Accurate supplier inventory syncing

* A working warehouse inventory system

* Clear separation between drop shipped products and warehouse-shipped products

* A functional 3PL/shipping integration

* Marketing systems connected to the store

* Automated customer follow-up workflows

* Clean reporting and analytics

* SOPs so our team can operate the system consistently

* A reliable foundation that can support nationwide sales growth



---



## Who We Are Looking For

title: Long-Form Video Editor (Full time)
description:
ABOUT AMPLIFY

We’re a remote-first, UK-based agency partnering with high-profile founders and entrepreneurs to grow their personal brands.

Our role is to turn their expertise into content that performs at scale.



ROLE OVERVIEW

We’re looking for a Long-Form Video Editor to support client delivery across podcasts, interviews, and YouTube content. This role is responsible for producing high-quality video assets while maintaining organised, efficient production workflows.



You will manage multiple client workloads simultaneously, balancing long-form edits with short-form derivatives, and ensuring all deliverables are completed to a high standard and on time.



This is a self-managed, accountable role suited to someone who can operate independently while communicating proactively within a remote team.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Edit long-form content (YouTube videos, podcasts, interviews) with strong pacing, clarity, and retention

- Extract and produce short-form clips from long-form content for social distribution

- Deliver final, publish-ready assets across all formats

- Organise projects and source files for efficient collaboration and handoff

- Manage deadlines across multiple client accounts and ensure consistent output

- Communicate proactively on progress, delays, and blockers

- Apply internal systems and workflows to maintain speed and consistency

- Leverage AI tools to improve production efficiency



CAPACITY & OUTPUT EXPECTATIONS

- Support 2–3 client workloads simultaneously, depending on scope

- Each workload may include:

- Long-form YouTube/podcast editing (core)

- Supporting short-form clip creation

Output expectations will vary depending on complexity and motion graphics requirements, but consistency and reliability are critical.



REQUIREMENTS

- Demonstrated experience editing long-form video content (YouTube, podcasts, interviews)

- Strong understanding of pacing, storytelling, and viewer retention

- Experience creating short-form content tailored to social platforms

- Proficiency in editing software (e.g. Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve)

- Familiarity with AI-assisted editing tools and workflows

- Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in parallel

- Strong organisational skills and clean file management practices

- Clear, reliable communication and ability to flag issues early

- Self-directed, accountable, and comfortable working in a remote environment



NICE TO HAVE

- Motion graphics / light animation

- Experience editing for founders, creators, or personal brands

- Understanding of platform-specific editing styles



WORKING STYLE

- Remote, async-friendly

- Deadline-driven and systems-oriented

- Focused on consistency, speed, and quality



COMPENSATION & WORKING TERMS

- Monthly compensation of $1,500–$2,500 (based on experience and performance)

- Flexible async working hours given hours are fulfilled and client deadlines are met

- 25 days paid leave per year



WHY JOIN AMPLIFY?

- Work with high-calibre clients

- Consistent, stable work

- Structured, efficient workflows

- Remote-first flexibility

title: Procurement Reconciliation Specialist
description:
Procurement Reconciliation Specialist

We are looking for someone who is:



* Extremely detail-oriented

* Honest and trustworthy

* Comfortable working with numbers

* Strong analytical mindset

* Able to identify discrepancies quickly

* Organized and systematic

* Patient with repetitive tasks



Main Responsibilities



* Review daily  purchases made by the procurement team.

* Match credit card transactions with purchased products.

* Verify that all purchased items were successfully received by the warehouse.

* Reconcile purchase records against credit card statements.

* Track pending credit card transactions until they are posted.

* Identify missing items, duplicate charges, pricing discrepancies, or incorrect purchases.

* Follow up with the procurement team when discrepancies are found.

* Maintain accurate reconciliation records and reports.

* Escalate unusual transactions or potential issues immediately.
